040a65209e6e877a.zh: 原因子句「모두가 찬성했기에」在前，後接主句賓語「그 계획을」修飾末尾動詞。
040a65209e6e877a.en: The reason clause 모두가 찬성했기에 comes first, followed by the object phrase 그 계획을 before 실행했다.

05a534af07a30200.zh: 過去式詞幹「했-」接「-을 따름이다」表示「只是做了…而已」。
05a534af07a30200.en: Past stem 했- correctly combines with -(으)ㄹ 따름이다 to express merely did.

05a534af07a30200.zh: 「했는」不能接依託名詞「따름」，句型固定用「-(으)ㄹ」。
05a534af07a30200.en: 했는 cannot modify the bound noun 따름; the construction strictly requires -(으)ㄹ.

05a534af07a30200.zh: 回想冠詞形「했던」表示過去曾有的回憶，無法搭配「따름이다」。
05a534af07a30200.en: Retrospective modifier 했던 does not pair with 따름이다 in this fixed expression.

05a534af07a30200.zh: 未完過去修飾「하던」表示過去常做，不能與「따름이다」搭配。
05a534af07a30200.en: Imperfective modifier 하던 cannot connect to the fixed pattern 따름이다.

0793f36a571493bd.zh: 地點「학교에」搭配慣用語「가든지 말든지」，最後以「네」修飾「마음대로」。
0793f36a571493bd.en: 학교에 precedes the contrasting pair 가든지 말든지, followed by possessive 네 qualifying 마음대로.

0931a338131c20cf.zh: 動詞「많아지다」接「-기 마련이다」，表示年紀大必然更關心健康。
0931a338131c20cf.en: 많아지기 correctly forms -기 마련이다 with 많아지다 to state a natural tendency.

0931a338131c20cf.zh: 「많아지는」是冠詞修飾形，不能直接連接「마련이다」。
0931a338131c20cf.en: 많아지는 is a relative clause ending and cannot attach to 마련이다.
많아져서 expresses cause or reason rather than the intended grammar pattern.

0931a338131c20cf.zh: 「많아지게도」帶有強調副詞語氣，不符合此句型結構。
0931a338131c20cf.en: 많아지게도 creates an adverbial clause and cannot link with 마련이다.

0938dc191200fc08.zh: 主語「옆집 개가」接副詞「계속」，再接動詞「짖어」與後方的「대서」結合。
0938dc191200fc08.en: The subject 옆집 개가 is followed by adverb 계속 and the stem 짖어, linking to 대서.

0a43a8dfe089e84f.zh: 對象「남에게」接動詞「부탁하느니」，再接副詞「차라리」修飾「혼자」。
0a43a8dfe089e84f.en: 남에게 connects to 부탁하느니, followed by 차라리 modifying 혼자 doing the action.

0c3c616a2fd71136.zh: 時間副詞매일置於首，接地點회사에서，後接句型자다시피 했어요（簡直住在公司）。
0c3c616a2fd71136.en: 매일 and 회사에서 set the time and place, preceding the pattern 자다시피 했어요 ('practically slept').

0c912fd0a37e8090.zh: 「걱정하다」接「-(으)ㄹ 만도 했다」，自然表達「難怪會擔心」。
0c912fd0a37e8090.en: 걱정할 만도 했지 correctly uses -(으)ㄹ 만도 하다 in the past tense.

0c912fd0a37e8090.zh: 此句型必須使用未來冠詞形「-(으)ㄹ」，不可使用現在形「-는」。
0c912fd0a37e8090.en: The grammar rule requires -(으)ㄹ, making the present ending -는 ungrammatical.

0c912fd0a37e8090.zh: 「만큼」表示程度，不能代替表示理應如此的「만」。
0c912fd0a37e8090.en: 만큼 indicates degree or comparison rather than natural consequence or reason.

0c912fd0a37e8090.zh: 「-기」為名詞形結尾，無法搭配「-(으)ㄹ 만도 하다」句型。
0c912fd0a37e8090.en: -기 turns verbs into nouns and does not form this grammatical pattern.

0e77119d6954b257.zh: 태도無收音，表示強調正是這種態度時接「야말로」。
0e77119d6954b257.en: 태도 ends in a vowel, so it correctly combines with 야말로 to emphasize it as the true key.
이야말로 attaches to nouns ending in a final consonant.

0e77119d6954b257.zh: 「마저」表示連最後的也……，不符合下定義的肯定句。
0e77119d6954b257.en: 마저 means even the last one, which does not fit an emphatic definition.

0e77119d6954b257.zh: 「조차」表示連……也，多用於極端或負面情況。
0e77119d6954b257.en: 조차 means even and expresses negative or extreme cases.

0f4d18af67778fe9.zh: 輔助動詞「-아/어 대다」接在陰性母音後用「-어」，表「不斷喧鬧」。
0f4d18af67778fe9.en: -어 is the correct vowel connector for stem 떠들- before the auxiliary verb 대다.

0f4d18af67778fe9.zh: 「-고」表示並列或連接，不能構成反覆動作的「-아/어 대다」。
0f4d18af67778fe9.en: -고 is a connective suffix for listing, not used before the auxiliary verb 대다.

0f4d18af67778fe9.zh: 「-게」表示使動或目的，無法與「대다」組合成表示反覆煩人的句型。
0f4d18af67778fe9.en: -게 expresses purpose or manner, which does not link with 대다 here.

0f4d18af67778fe9.zh: 「-지」通常用於否定「-지 않다」，不能與「대다」搭配。
0f4d18af67778fe9.en: -지 connects to negative forms like 않다, not to the auxiliary 대다.

107a6f15eaad24bf.zh: 受詞돈을接動詞빌릴，再接바에야表「與其」，後接副詞아예修飾안 사겠어요。
107a6f15eaad24bf.en: 돈을 serves as object to 빌릴, which attaches to 바에야; 아예 modifies 안 사겠어요.

118cdf125be6a2a0.zh: 副詞「직접」修飾「해 보고서야」（親自嘗試後才），後接疑問副詞「얼마나」。
118cdf125be6a2a0.en: Adverb 직접 modifies 해 보고서야 (only after trying), which is followed by 얼마나 to introduce the clause.

12650d16af8e95d2.zh: 「떨어져 있길래」表示看到皮夾掉在地上這個狀況，因此把它送去警察局，完全符合文法。
12650d16af8e95d2.en: 있길래 attaches to the observed state 떨어져 있다 to express the reason for taking it to the police.

12650d16af8e95d2.zh: 「있느라」表示因忙於維持某狀態而無法做其他事，主語必須是有意志的主體，此處不合。
12650d16af8e95d2.en: 있느라 requires an intentional subject busy doing something, which does not apply to a dropped wallet.

12650d16af8e95d2.zh: 「있다면」表示假設「如果掉在地上」，但後半句是已經完成的實際行動，不能用假設。
12650d16af8e95d2.en: 있다면 means if it were, but the following clause reports a completed real action.

12650d16af8e95d2.zh: 「있으려고」表示目的「為了在……」，皮夾掉在地上並非意志行為，語法與語意皆不符。
12650d16af8e95d2.en: 있으려고 expresses intention (in order to stay), which cannot apply to an inanimate dropped object.

12dc71256ff54988.zh: 영화無收音，表示正是這部電影時接「야말로」。
12dc71256ff54988.en: 영화 ends in a vowel, so it takes 야말로 to emphasize that this film is truly the best.
이야말로 attaches to nouns with a final consonant.

12dc71256ff54988.zh: 「마저」表示連最後剩下的也……，多用於負面情境。
12dc71256ff54988.en: 마저 means even the last remaining one, typically used in negative situations.

12dc71256ff54988.zh: 「이나」表示或者或高達，不表示強調正片最高。
12dc71256ff54988.en: 이나 indicates an option or an unexpectedly large quantity, not strong affirmation.

13546126e4d5a089.zh: 「-치고는」接在名詞後，表示就該名詞的標準而言出乎意料。
13546126e4d5a089.en: 치고는 attaches to a noun to mean considering the standard, surprisingly so.

13546126e4d5a089.zh: 「조차」表示「連…也」，用於強調連最基本的都不例外，此處不合。
13546126e4d5a089.en: 조차 means even and marks an extreme case, which does not fit here.

13546126e4d5a089.zh: 「마저」表示「連最後剩下的也…」，多用於負面情境。
13546126e4d5a089.en: 마저 means even the last remaining, typically used in negative situations.

13546126e4d5a089.zh: 「부터」表示起點「從…起」，在此無法表達評斷標準。
13546126e4d5a089.en: 부터 means starting from and cannot indicate an evaluative standard.

135b256af3779a7f.zh: 動詞「실수하다」接上語法「-(으)ㄹ 만도 하다」，應變為「실수할」。
135b256af3779a7f.en: Under the pattern -(으)ㄹ 만도 하다, the stem 실수하- takes -ㄹ to become 실수할.

135b256af3779a7f.zh: 「하는」為現在冠詞形，不能用於「-(으)ㄹ 만도 하다」句型。
135b256af3779a7f.en: 하는 is the present noun-modifying ending, not matching -(으)ㄹ 만도 하다.

135b256af3779a7f.zh: 「한」為過去冠詞形，不符合「-(으)ㄹ 만도 하다」的文法規則。
135b256af3779a7f.en: 한 is the past-tense adnominal ending and cannot pair with 만도 하다.

135b256af3779a7f.zh: 「해」為非格式體口語結尾，無法直接修飾依存名詞「만」。
135b256af3779a7f.en: 해 is an informal ending and cannot modify the bound noun 만.

16272e6d4833c740.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ지언정」後接絕不肯做的事，表達寧可輸也絕不犯規的決心。
16272e6d4833c740.en: -(으)ㄹ지언정 is followed by a strong refusal, meaning I would rather lose than commit a foul.

16272e6d4833c740.zh: 「반칙을 하겠어요」意為會犯規，與寧可輸也不犯規的強烈決心矛盾。
16272e6d4833c740.en: 반칙을 하겠어요 means will foul, contradicting the resolve to never commit a foul even if losing.

16272e6d4833c740.zh: 「반칙을 했어요」是過去式陳述句，無法與表示堅決意志的文法搭配。
16272e6d4833c740.en: 반칙을 했어요 is a past-tense statement, which does not fit the pattern expressing strong future resolve.

16272e6d4833c740.zh: 「반칙이 많아요」意為犯規很多，只是客觀描述，語意無法銜接。
16272e6d4833c740.en: 반칙이 많아요 merely describes an abundance of fouls, failing to express a refusal or determination.

186b021b3cc931a2.zh: 「-기에」接在過去式後表示原因，「因為他真誠道歉，所以原諒了他」。
186b021b3cc931a2.en: -기에 follows past tense to state a reason: as he apologized sincerely, I forgave him.

186b021b3cc931a2.zh: 「-기로」常用於約定或決定（-기로 하다），不能用於陳述原諒的原因。
186b021b3cc931a2.en: -기로 is used for decisions (with 하다), not for stating the reason for forgiving.

186b021b3cc931a2.zh: 「-기를」是名詞形受格助詞，通常後接「바라다」（希望）等動詞。
186b021b3cc931a2.en: -기를 is an object marker after nominalization, usually followed by verbs like 바라다.

186b021b3cc931a2.zh: 「-기만」表示限定「僅僅、只是」，無法表達前後的因果關係。
186b021b3cc931a2.en: -기만 means only or just, which does not express a causal link.

18810bfd89a03da4.zh: 大主語「아이의 습관은」接從句主語「부모가」，再接修飾「가르치기」。
18810bfd89a03da4.en: The topic 아이의 습관은 is followed by sub-subject 부모가 and verb 가르치기 before 나름이에요.

1883ef18254c63bc.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 바에야」表示「與其…倒不如…」，符合後句提議搭計程車的語境。
1883ef18254c63bc.en: -(으)ㄹ 바에야 expresses 'rather than (do something)', fitting the suggestion to take a taxi.

1883ef18254c63bc.zh: 「바람에」表示非預期的消極原因，且前面需接「-는」而非「-(으)ㄹ」。
1883ef18254c63bc.en: 바람에 expresses an unexpected negative cause and takes -는, not -(으)ㄹ.

1883ef18254c63bc.zh: 「김에」表示「趁著…之便」，與前後文的無奈取捨語意不符。
1883ef18254c63bc.en: 김에 means 'while one is at it / taking the opportunity', which does not fit.

1883ef18254c63bc.zh: 「탓에」表示壞結果的原因（怪罪於…），且通常接「-(으)ㄴ/는」。
1883ef18254c63bc.en: 탓에 blames a factor for a bad result and does not take -(으)ㄹ in this context.

190e5e8bf52c6c29.zh: 「겉만 보고 판단하면」形成假設條件，後接易失誤的「실수하기 십상이에요」。
190e5e8bf52c6c29.en: 겉만 보고 connects to conditional 판단하면, which naturally leads to the negative consequence 실수하기 십상이에요.

1917e402f2462e04.en: The pattern is N은/는 물론; 아이들 has a final consonant, so it takes은.

1917e402f2462e04.zh: 「이」是主格助詞，不符合「N은/는 물론」的固定搭配。
1917e402f2462e04.en: 이 is a subject particle and does not fit the pattern N은/는 물론.

1917e402f2462e04.zh: 「을」是受格助詞，不符合「N은/는 물론」的文法。
1917e402f2462e04.en: 을 is an object particle and cannot be used in N은/는 물론.

1917e402f2462e04.zh: 「에」是副詞格助詞，此處應使用主題助詞搭配물론。
1917e402f2462e04.en: 에 is a location/time particle and cannot form the pattern with 물론.

197a64bc4c1b6b89.zh: 名詞「영광」接指定詞「-일 따름입니다」，表示「只是榮幸而已」。
197a64bc4c1b6b89.en: Noun 영광 attaches to -일 따름입니다 to express it is simply an honour.

197a64bc4c1b6b89.zh: 名詞冠詞形「인」不能搭配「따름입니다」，句型需用「-(으)ㄹ」。
197a64bc4c1b6b89.en: Present modifier 인 does not combine with 따름입니다; the pattern requires -(으)ㄹ.

197a64bc4c1b6b89.zh: 句型結尾必須是形容詞「이다」，不能造出「따름합니다」的形式。
197a64bc4c1b6b89.en: The pattern ends in the copula 이다; 따름합니다 is an incorrect form.

197a64bc4c1b6b89.zh: 並列詞尾「이고」不能直接修飾或連接「따름입니다」。
197a64bc4c1b6b89.en: Connective 이고 cannot modify or link directly to the noun 따름입니다.

1c0afdec6f727dcd.zh: 副詞「그렇게」修飾原因「혼났으니」，再接主句「울 만도 하지요」。
1c0afdec6f727dcd.en: Adverb 그렇게 modifies the reason 혼났으니, leading naturally into the pattern 울 만도 하지요.

1c0ebfd9d84ffb49.zh: 「-기에」表示原因或理由，用於書面語，意為「因為堵車」。
1c0ebfd9d84ffb49.en: -기에 expresses a written cause or reason, meaning because the roads were jammed.

1c0ebfd9d84ffb49.zh: 「-기로」常用於「-기로 하다」表示決定，不能單獨表示原因。
1c0ebfd9d84ffb49.en: -기로 is typically used in -기로 하다 to mean decide to, not for expressing a cause.

1c0ebfd9d84ffb49.zh: 「-기도」表示「也做某事」或「-기도 하다」，不表因果關係。
1c0ebfd9d84ffb49.en: -기도 expresses also doing something or sometimes does, not a cause.

1c0ebfd9d84ffb49.zh: 「-기만」表示「光是、只」，語意為「只要堵車就…」，不合句意。
1c0ebfd9d84ffb49.en: -기만 means only or just, which does not fit the cause-and-effect meaning here.

1c2046878206c7d2.zh: 以외국인치고는提出外國人標準，接主語한국어 발음이與副詞정말。
1c2046878206c7d2.en: 외국인치고는 sets the standard for a foreigner, followed by subject 한국어 발음이 and adverb 정말.

1d1e3721af49306c.zh: 名詞後直接接「나름이에요」，表示「取決於…（的名詞）」。
1d1e3721af49306c.en: Nouns connect directly to 나름이에요 to mean depends on the noun.

1d1e3721af49306c.zh: 「마련이에요」表示必然發生的事理，且通常接在動詞「-기」後。
1d1e3721af49306c.en: 마련이에요 means naturally bound to happen and typically follows -기.

1d1e3721af49306c.zh: 「십상이에요」表示容易造成負面結果，且通常接在動詞「-기」後。
1d1e3721af49306c.en: 십상이에요 means prone to bad outcomes and typically follows -기.

1d1e3721af49306c.zh: 「법이에요」表示自然規律，且前面需接定語形詞尾，不直接接名詞。
1d1e3721af49306c.en: 법이에요 means it is natural that and requires an adnominal ending, not bare nouns.

1ea89093ec3f45a7.zh: 動詞表示「取決於…」時，慣用句型為「-기 나름이다」。
1ea89093ec3f45a7.en: The grammar pattern meaning depends on doing something is -기 나름이다.

1ea89093ec3f45a7.zh: 「-는」為冠詞形詞尾，不能直接接在動詞詞幹後搭配「나름이다」。
1ea89093ec3f45a7.en: -는 is an adnominal ending and does not form the pattern -기 나름이다.

1ea89093ec3f45a7.zh: 「-고」表示並列或時間順序，不能搭配「나름이다」。
1ea89093ec3f45a7.en: -고 connects clauses and cannot be followed directly by 나름이다.
-게 turns verbs into adverbs and cannot combine with 나름이다.

1f9fed4a74cc01a7.zh: 形容詞「고프다」後接「길래」，表示因自己察覺肚子餓而採取後續行動。
1f9fed4a74cc01a7.en: -길래 attaches to 고프- to indicate the speaker's noticed condition that prompted making ramen.

1f9fed4a74cc01a7.zh: 「거든」用於向對方提示事實作為前提，或在句尾表示原因，不接在此處的因果句中。
1f9fed4a74cc01a7.en: 거든 presents a condition or background fact to the listener, not a simple past reason for an action.

1f9fed4a74cc01a7.zh: 「다면」表示假設「如果……的話」，此處是已發生的事實，不能用假設。
1f9fed4a74cc01a7.en: 다면 expresses a hypothetical condition (if), but this sentence describes an actual event.

1f9fed4a74cc01a7.zh: 「려고」表示目的「打算……」，形容詞「배가 고프다」無法接「려고」表達意圖。
1f9fed4a74cc01a7.en: 려고 expresses intention or purpose and cannot attach to an adjective like 배가 고프다.

2153b31813ef4bea.zh: 主詞「모든 일은」接動詞短語「마음먹기」，最後接句尾「나름이에요」。
2153b31813ef4bea.en: The subject 모든 일은 is followed by the nominalized 마음먹기 and completed with the pattern 나름이에요.

247e2e3fc628175e.zh: 動詞詞幹接「-기 십상이에요」表示非常容易耗盡，符合句型規則。
247e2e3fc628175e.en: Attaching -기 십상이에요 to the verb stem correctly forms the pattern meaning very likely to run out.

247e2e3fc628175e.zh: 冠詞形結尾「바닥나는」不能修飾「십상이에요」，語法錯誤。
247e2e3fc628175e.en: The modifier ending 바닥나는 cannot precede 십상이에요; nominalizing with -기 is required.

247e2e3fc628175e.zh: 「십상이다」是形容詞性慣用語，不能換成命令或敬語動詞「십상하세요」。
247e2e3fc628175e.en: 십상이다 is a predicate with 이다; it cannot take imperative or honorific 십상하세요.

247e2e3fc628175e.zh: 副詞形結尾「바닥나게」不能與「십상이에요」搭配。
247e2e3fc628175e.en: Adverbial 바닥나게 does not connect with 십상이에요; the grammar pattern demands -기.

2515042373f65111.zh: 動詞詞幹接「는 가운데」表示在某種情況進行之中，符合文意。
2515042373f65111.en: Attaching 는 가운데 to a verb stem indicates that an action occurs amid an ongoing situation.

2515042373f65111.zh: 名詞化詞尾「기」不能直接修飾依託名詞「가운데」。
2515042373f65111.en: The nominalizer 기 cannot directly modify the dependent noun 가운데.

2515042373f65111.zh: 連接詞尾「고」表示並列，不能在此修飾「가운데」。
2515042373f65111.en: The connective 고 indicates parallel actions and cannot modify 가운데 here.

2515042373f65111.zh: 「도록」表示目的或程度，不能與「가운데」搭配構成此句型。
2515042373f65111.en: 도록 expresses purpose or degree, not the modifier needed before 가운데.

260387d8e54be6fc.zh: 副詞「이렇게 계속」修飾「굶다가는」，引出警告結果「쓰러질 거예요」。
260387d8e54be6fc.en: Adverbs 이렇게 and 계속 modify 굶다가는, which sets up the warning clause ending in 쓰러질 거예요.

260f4a6a27b0312c.zh: 名詞「직원」後接「-인 이상」，表示「既然身為員工」。
260f4a6a27b0312c.en: The noun 직원 takes 인 to form 인 이상, meaning 'since one is an employee'.

260f4a6a27b0312c.zh: 「이는」不是接名詞修飾「이상」的正確型態。
260f4a6a27b0312c.en: 이는 is not the correct modifier form for nouns before 이상.

260f4a6a27b0312c.zh: 「-일」表推測或將來，不符已確立的身分。
260f4a6a27b0312c.en: 일 indicates future or supposition, not an established role.

260f4a6a27b0312c.zh: 「-이라」是引述或接續形態，後面不能直接接「이상」。
260f4a6a27b0312c.en: 이라 is a clausal connective or quotative form, not used before 이상.

288029d1857c60f5.zh: 主語「날씨가」配謂語「맑기에」表原因，後接副詞「오랜만에」與賓語「산책을」。
288029d1857c60f5.en: Subject 날씨가 pairs with predicate 맑기에 expressing cause, followed by adverb 오랜만에 and object 산책을.

2abfa0d1b761f211.zh: 過去詞幹「했-」接「-을 따름입니다」，表示「只不過是照著做而已」。
2abfa0d1b761f211.en: Past stem 했- correctly takes -(으)ㄹ 따름입니다 to convey I simply did as told.

2abfa0d1b761f211.zh: 過去冠詞形「한」不能接依託名詞「따름」，必須使用「-(으)ㄹ」。
2abfa0d1b761f211.en: Modifier ending 한 cannot combine with 따름; the pattern demands -(으)ㄹ.

2abfa0d1b761f211.zh: 「했는」是錯誤的修飾形式，無法與「따름입니다」搭配。
2abfa0d1b761f211.en: 했는 is an invalid modifier here; the construction requires -(으)ㄹ 따름입니다.

2abfa0d1b761f211.zh: 連接詞尾「하고」表示並列，無法連接「따름입니다」。
2abfa0d1b761f211.en: Connective suffix 하고 cannot link into the noun phrase 따름입니다.

2d5836e06bd8ef9b.zh: 動詞詞幹接「-(으)ㄹ 바에야」，表示「與其…不如…」。
2d5836e06bd8ef9b.en: Attach -(으)ㄹ 바에야 to a verb stem to express 'rather than do ...'.

2d5836e06bd8ef9b.zh: 「-는」是現在式冠形詞尾，不能與「바에야」搭配表示此句型。
2d5836e06bd8ef9b.en: -는 is the present modifier and does not pair with 바에야 for this pattern.

2d5836e06bd8ef9b.zh: 「-(으)ㄴ」是過去式冠形詞尾，不符合「-(으)ㄹ 바에야」的接續規則。
2d5836e06bd8ef9b.en: -(으)ㄴ is the past modifier and does not form the -(으)ㄹ 바에야 structure.

2d5836e06bd8ef9b.zh: 「-기」是名詞形轉化詞尾，後方不能直接接「바에야」。
2d5836e06bd8ef9b.en: -기 turns verbs into nouns and cannot directly combine with 바에야 here.

2d6a1b34a239d966.zh: 條件句「서두르면」接副詞「오히려」與受詞「일을」，最後接修飾語「그르치는」。
2d6a1b34a239d966.en: The conditional 서두르면 leads into adverb 오히려, object 일을, and adjective/verb modifier 그르치는 before 법이에요.

2e08ac320b91c20a.zh: 副詞「처음에는」置首，主語「누구나」接動詞與句型「실수하기 마련이에요」。
2e08ac320b91c20a.en: The time phrase 처음에는 begins the sentence, followed by subject 누구나, completed by the pattern 실수하기 마련이에요.

2eb12dbeb97f7922.zh: 「알아내다」表示克服困難、經過努力後終於找出答案，過去式為「냈어요」。
2eb12dbeb97f7922.en: 알아내다 means to find out or figure out after effort; its polite past form is 냈어요.

2eb12dbeb97f7922.zh: 「났어요」為「나다」的過去式，不能接在「알아」後面構成慣用語。
2eb12dbeb97f7922.en: 났어요 comes from 나다 and does not form the auxiliary pattern with 알아.

2eb12dbeb97f7922.zh: 「놨어요」是「놓다」（保持狀態）的過去式，無法表達終於找出答案。
2eb12dbeb97f7922.en: 놨어요 comes from 놓다 (to keep/leave), not matching the sense of finding out.

2eb12dbeb97f7922.zh: 「넣었어요」是「넣다」（放入）的過去式，與找出答案的文意無關。
2eb12dbeb97f7922.en: 넣었어요 is from 넣다 (to put in), which does not make sense here.

2fa1940e58ffb037.zh: 動詞後接「느니」表示「與其…不如…」，常與「차라리」呼應。
2fa1940e58ffb037.en: 느니 attaches to a verb stem to mean 'rather than', naturally pairing with 차라리.

2fa1940e58ffb037.zh: 「니까」表示原因或理由（因為），語義與前後文不合。
2fa1940e58ffb037.en: 니까 indicates reason or cause (because), which does not fit the contrastive comparison.

2fa1940e58ffb037.zh: 「려고」表示意圖或目的（為了），無法與「차라리」連用表達取捨。
2fa1940e58ffb037.en: 려고 expresses intention or purpose (in order to), which does not express preference.

2fa1940e58ffb037.zh: 「면서」表示同時進行兩種動作（邊…邊…），語義不符。
2fa1940e58ffb037.en: 면서 indicates simultaneous actions (while), which makes no sense here.

312e1870eb703826.zh: 受詞「아침을」接動詞「먹는」，依序與「둥」、「마는」組成固定句型「먹는 둥 마는 둥」。
312e1870eb703826.en: Object 아침을 takes verb 먹는, which with 둥 and 마는 forms the set grammar pattern V-는 둥 마는 둥.

3266d9265a4537a9.zh: 「-다가는」表示持續做某動作將會導致負面後果（出車禍）。
3266d9265a4537a9.en: -다가는 warns that continuing an action (speeding) will lead to a bad result.

3266d9265a4537a9.zh: 「-다가도」表示「雖然……但也」，無法表達負面預警。
3266d9265a4537a9.en: 다가도 means 'even while doing', which does not express a warning of negative results.

3266d9265a4537a9.zh: 「-느라고」表示因某動作導致不良結果，用於已發生的理由。
3266d9265a4537a9.en: 느라고 explains an already realized negative consequence, not a hypothetical future warning.

3266d9265a4537a9.zh: 「-자마자」表示「一……就……」，不具預警不良後果之意。
3266d9265a4537a9.en: 자마자 means 'as soon as', indicating immediate sequence rather than a cautionary consequence.

33a24b4beadadebe.zh: 「넘고서야」表示「直到超過……之後才」，符合句意「過了十點才結束」。
33a24b4beadadebe.en: 넘고서야 means only after exceeding, fitting the meaning of ending only after 10 p.m.

33a24b4beadadebe.zh: 「넘느라」表示因忙於某動作而導致負面結果，不合時間後綴用法。
33a24b4beadadebe.en: 넘느라 expresses a reason for a negative outcome due to doing something, which does not fit here.

33a24b4beadadebe.zh: 「넘도록」表示「到了超過……的程度/直到」，後方通常接持續性動作。
33a24b4beadadebe.en: 넘도록 means to the extent of passing or until, not matching the emphatic only after nuance.

33a24b4beadadebe.zh: 「넘자고」表示提議「一起超過吧」，與句意毫無關聯。
33a24b4beadadebe.en: 넘자고 means let's exceed, a proposal ending that makes no sense here.

34face70b05fb8d0.zh: 「真相既已揭曉」順理成章接「無法再隱瞞」。
34face70b05fb8d0.en: Since the truth is revealed, 숨길 수 없을 거예요 logically follows as the negative consequence.

34face70b05fb8d0.zh: 「將能夠隱瞞」語意矛盾，真相揭曉後無法繼續隱瞞。
34face70b05fb8d0.en: 숨길 수 있을 거예요 creates a contradiction since the truth is already known.

34face70b05fb8d0.zh: 「容易隱瞞」與事實揭曉的前提完全不符。
34face70b05fb8d0.en: 숨기기 쉬울 거예요 contradicts the fact that the truth has come to light.

34face70b05fb8d0.zh: 「隱瞞比較好」不合常理，且忽視了真相已曝光的事實。
34face70b05fb8d0.en: 숨기는 게 좋겠어요 does not make sense once the truth is already out.

351bfc35b093df24.zh: 「고객의 의견을」接目的「듣고자」，再接名詞「설문」修飾後面的調查。
351bfc35b093df24.en: 고객의 의견을 is the object of 듣고자 expressing purpose, modifying the noun 설문 which heads 조사를.

3566ef1ae98ede6a.zh: 動詞詞幹接「-다시피 하다」，表示「幾乎、簡直…」。
3566ef1ae98ede6a.en: -다시피 하다 expresses that something was 'practically' or 'almost' done.

3566ef1ae98ede6a.zh: 「-느라」後方不能直接搭配「했어요」構成此固定文法結構。
3566ef1ae98ede6a.en: -느라 cannot pair with 했어요 to mean 'practically did something'.

3566ef1ae98ede6a.zh: 「-다가」表示中斷或轉折，不能接「했어요」表達「簡直徹夜未眠」。
3566ef1ae98ede6a.en: -다가 indicates interruption and does not combine with 했어요 in this sense.

3566ef1ae98ede6a.zh: 「-도록」表示程度或使動，不與「하다」構成「簡直、幾乎」之意。
3566ef1ae98ede6a.en: -도록 expresses degree or purpose, not the idiomatic 'practically did' meaning.

392fb536bd002812.zh: 「-는 둥 마는 둥 하다」是固定句型，表示馬馬虎虎、幾乎沒做。
392fb536bd002812.en: V-는 둥 마는 둥 하다 is a fixed pattern expressing doing an action half-heartedly.

392fb536bd002812.zh: 「-는 척」表示「裝作…」，無法與後面的「마는 둥」構成相應句型。
392fb536bd002812.en: 척 is used in -는 척하다 (pretending to), which does not pair with 마는 둥.

392fb536bd002812.zh: 「-는 김에」表示「順便…」，無法與後面的「마는 둥」搭配。
392fb536bd002812.en: 김 is used in -는 김에 (while one is at it), not in this paired structure.

392fb536bd002812.zh: 「-는 탓」表示「因為…（壞結果）」，無法與後方詞語搭配。
392fb536bd002812.en: 탓 indicates a negative reason or blame, not matching the paired structure.

3aaebff8bbb42d2c.zh: 가족有收音，表示強調正是家族時接「이야말로」。
3aaebff8bbb42d2c.en: 가족 ends in a final consonant, so it takes이야말로 to strongly emphasize it as the most precious thing.
야말로 attaches to nouns without a final consonant.

3aaebff8bbb42d2c.zh: 「이나마」表示退而求其次的哪怕是、即使是，不表強調肯定。
3aaebff8bbb42d2c.en: 이나마 means even if only or at least, expressing compromise rather than strong emphasis.

3aaebff8bbb42d2c.zh: 「조차」表示連……也，通常用於負面或極端情況。
3aaebff8bbb42d2c.en: 조차 means even and is usually used in unexpected negative contexts.

3b7d6a5e38cb59ae.zh: 與前方的「하고」結合構成「-고서야」，表示「只有在做完…之後才…」。
3b7d6a5e38cb59ae.en: Combines with 하고 to form -고서야, meaning only after finishing the homework did I sleep.

3b7d6a5e38cb59ae.zh: 「-려고」表示意圖或目的，不能接在「하고」後面構成「하고려고」。
3b7d6a5e38cb59ae.en: -려고 expresses intention or purpose and cannot attach after 하고.

3b7d6a5e38cb59ae.zh: 「-자」表示一…就…，不能直接接在「하고」之後構成「하고자」來表達時間後續。
3b7d6a5e38cb59ae.en: -자 means as soon as, and cannot attach after 하고 to mean only after.

3b7d6a5e38cb59ae.zh: 「-도록」表示做到某程度或為了某目的，不能直接接在「하고」後面搭配。
3b7d6a5e38cb59ae.en: -도록 expresses extent or purpose and cannot properly attach onto 하고 here.

3c4d5f1010acdb0a.zh: 「-기에」可用於表示評價的基準或範圍，「對一個人做而言太吃力」。
3c4d5f1010acdb0a.en: -기에 indicates the standard or domain of judgment: too demanding for doing alone.

3c4d5f1010acdb0a.zh: 「-기로」通常接「하다」表示決定，不能作為後續評價的基準。
3c4d5f1010acdb0a.en: -기로 typically pairs with 하다 to mean deciding to, not a standard for judgment.

3c4d5f1010acdb0a.zh: 「-기를」是名詞形加受格助詞，無法修飾後方的形容詞「벅차다」。
3c4d5f1010acdb0a.en: -기를 is an object marker and cannot modify the adjective 벅차다.

3c4d5f1010acdb0a.zh: 「-기와」為名詞形加助詞「與」，文法不通且語意不合。
3c4d5f1010acdb0a.en: -기와 combines nominalization with the particle with, which is ungrammatical here.

3f0407ba59390179.zh: 「-고자 하다」為固定文法，在正式陳述中表示「打算、想要闡明」。
3f0407ba59390179.en: -고자 하다 is the formal construction meaning intend to or would like to.

3f0407ba59390179.zh: 「-고서」表動作接續（做完…之後），不能與「하다」搭配成意圖句型。
3f0407ba59390179.en: -고서 expresses sequence (after doing) and cannot combine with 하다 to express intent.

3f0407ba59390179.zh: 「-(으)려다가」表示本來打算做某事但中途改變，後不接「하다」。
3f0407ba59390179.en: -(으)려다가 indicates an intention that was changed or interrupted, not followed by 하다.

3f0407ba59390179.zh: 「-느라」表因某事而耽誤或產生不良後果，不能與「하다」連用表意圖。
3f0407ba59390179.en: -느라 indicates a time-consuming cause of a negative result, not paired with 하다.

409281b6c46a2ef7.zh: 前後對比，「空氣清新」的相反缺點是「交通不便」。
409281b6c46a2ef7.en: Contrasting with clean air, 교통이 불편하다 provides an opposite, negative aspect.

409281b6c46a2ef7.zh: 「空氣非常好」是重複優點，無法形成對比。
409281b6c46a2ef7.en: 공기가 아주 맑다 repeats the positive point instead of contrasting.

409281b6c46a2ef7.zh: 「景色也很美」是並列優點，不能用「-는 데 반해」。
409281b6c46a2ef7.en: 경치도 아름답다 adds another positive feature instead of making a contrast.

409281b6c46a2ef7.zh: 「人們很親切」也是優點，與前句構不成反差。
409281b6c46a2ef7.en: 사람들이 친절하다 is another positive trait, so it does not contrast.

4541ff92a3dc3428.zh: 動詞「웃다」有收音，接「-을」構成「웃을 바에야」（與其笑…）。
4541ff92a3dc3428.en: Consonant-final stem 웃- takes -을 to form the pattern 웃을 바에야 ('rather than laugh').

4541ff92a3dc3428.zh: 「는」是現在式修飾語尾，本句型固定使用未來式修飾語尾「-(으)ㄹ」。
4541ff92a3dc3428.en: 는 is the present modifier; this grammar requires the prospective modifier -(으)ㄹ.

4541ff92a3dc3428.zh: 「은」是過去式修飾語尾，不能與「바에야」組合成此取捨句型。
4541ff92a3dc3428.en: 은 is the past modifier, which does not form this hypothetical preference structure.

4541ff92a3dc3428.zh: 「어」是副詞形接續詞尾，不能修飾依存名詞「바」。
4541ff92a3dc3428.en: 어 is a connective ending and cannot grammatically modify the dependent noun 바.

4760f9ce476cabc7.zh: 句型「N에 불과하다」固定使用助詞「에」，表示「只不過是…」。
4760f9ce476cabc7.en: N에 불과하다 is a fixed expression requiring particle 에 to mean merely N.

4760f9ce476cabc7.zh: 主格助詞「이」在此不符合「에 불과하다」的固定文法搭配。
4760f9ce476cabc7.en: Subject particle 이 does not fit the fixed pattern 에 불과하다.

4760f9ce476cabc7.zh: 受格助詞「을」不能與自動詞性質的「불과하다」搭配。
4760f9ce476cabc7.en: Object particle 을 cannot be used with the intransitive predicate 불과하다.

4760f9ce476cabc7.zh: 助詞「로」表示方向或手段，不能用於「에 불과하다」句型。
4760f9ce476cabc7.en: Particle 로 denotes means or direction, not the target required by 불과하다.

47af207ae8631e6c.zh: 「名詞+치고」搭配後方否定句「없다」，表示「凡是…都無一例外」。
47af207ae8631e6c.en: N치고 combined with a negative predicate means every N without exception.

47af207ae8631e6c.zh: 「부터」表示起始點，無法與後方的全體否定句搭配成此句型。
47af207ae8631e6c.en: 부터 indicates a starting point, not the without-exception construction.

47af207ae8631e6c.zh: 「까지」表示範圍終點「到…為止」，不符合全稱無例外的語意。
47af207ae8631e6c.en: 까지 means until or up to and cannot express an all-inclusive negation.

47af207ae8631e6c.zh: 「조차」表示連…也，放入句中語法結構與「沒有人不喜歡」不相合。
47af207ae8631e6c.en: 조차 means even, which does not form the generalization without exception.

485aff3ae66cd9ef.zh: 「-기 십상이다」是固定句型，表示很容易發生某種負面結果。
485aff3ae66cd9ef.en: -기 십상이다 is the fixed pattern meaning very likely to experience something bad.

485aff3ae66cd9ef.zh: 冠詞形結尾「는」不能接「십상이다」，必須使用名詞形「기」。
485aff3ae66cd9ef.en: The modifying suffix 는 cannot attach directly to 십상이다; the nominalizer 기 is required.

485aff3ae66cd9ef.zh: 副詞形「게」在此無法與「십상이다」搭配，句型固定為「-기 십상이다」。
485aff3ae66cd9ef.en: Adverbial 게 does not pair with 십상이다; the pattern strictly requires -기 십상이다.

485aff3ae66cd9ef.zh: 連接詞尾「아」不能直接連接「십상이다」，語法不成立。
485aff3ae66cd9ef.en: Connective ending 아 cannot attach to 십상이다; the pattern requires the nominalizer 기.

4b1149be6dec4a82.en: 감사하다 ends in a vowel, so it takes -(으)ㄹ 따름이다 to form 감사할.

4b1149be6dec4a82.zh: 冠詞形「하는」表示現在進行或習慣修飾，不能接「따름이다」。
4b1149be6dec4a82.en: Present modifier 하는 cannot attach to 따름이다; future/prospective -(으)ㄹ is required.

4b1149be6dec4a82.zh: 過去冠詞形「한」不能與表示當前心境的「따름이다」搭配。
4b1149be6dec4a82.en: Past modifier 한 is grammatically incompatible with the standard -(으)ㄹ 따름이다 pattern here.

4b1149be6dec4a82.zh: 原因結尾「해서」無法修飾依託名詞「따름」，語法錯誤。
4b1149be6dec4a82.en: Causal ending 해서 cannot modify the bound noun 따름; the pattern requires -(으)ㄹ.

4b148a870eb913f2.zh: 主題오늘은接겨울 날씨치고는表示以冬天標準而言，修飾副詞꽤及形容詞。
4b148a870eb913f2.en: Topic 오늘은 leads into 겨울 날씨치고는 for the winter standard, modifying adverb 꽤 and 따뜻하네요.

4e13a29e01db7221.zh: 副詞「조금만 더 일찍」修飾過去假設條件「왔더라면」，連接後面的推測結果句。
4e13a29e01db7221.en: Adverbs 조금만 더 일찍 modify the past counterfactual verb 왔더라면, which connects smoothly to the main clause.

4ee4be9acb1f8fcb.zh: 主詞「그것은」後接修飾語「한 사람의 의견에」，最後接「불과해요」構成「N에 불과하다」。
4ee4be9acb1f8fcb.en: Subject 그것은 is followed by the modified noun phrase 한 사람의 의견에, which connects into the pattern N에 불과해요.

4ee4fe9df10bafce.zh: 「-기 마련이다」表示理所當然的常理，動詞詞幹接「하기」。
4ee4fe9df10bafce.en: The pattern -기 마련이다 expresses a natural rule, so 하다 takes 하기.

4ee4fe9df10bafce.zh: 「하는」是冠詞形修飾名詞，不能直接接「마련이다」。
4ee4fe9df10bafce.en: 하는 is a noun-modifying form and does not combine with 마련이다.

4ee4fe9df10bafce.zh: 「해서」表示原因或順序，不能用在此句型中。
4ee4fe9df10bafce.en: 해서 expresses cause or sequential action, not this pattern.

4ee4fe9df10bafce.zh: 「하고」表示並列或連接，無法與「마련이다」搭配。
4ee4fe9df10bafce.en: 하고 connects clauses or items in parallel and cannot connect to 마련이다.

50ba56ccff85230f.zh: 受格結構「여러분의 응원에」接謂語「감사할」，後接「따름입니다」。
50ba56ccff85230f.en: Noun phrase 여러분의 응원에 sets the target for 감사할, which completes the pattern with 따름입니다.

547515044f678d40.zh: 「싸우다」加上「-기 마련이에요」，表示再好的朋友偶爾也會吵架。
547515044f678d40.en: 싸우기 마련이에요 correctly applies -기 마련이다 to state that even close friends naturally fight.

547515044f678d40.zh: 句型固定為「-기 마련이다」，不能換成定語形「싸우는」。
547515044f678d40.en: The grammar rule requires -기 마련이다, not the modifying 싸우는.

547515044f678d40.zh: 「마련하세요」是祈使句要求對方準備，不符必然常理的句意。
547515044f678d40.en: 마련하세요 is an imperative meaning please prepare, which makes no sense here.

547515044f678d40.zh: 「싸우게 마련해요」並非自然常理的句型，文法與語意均不通。
547515044f678d40.en: 싸우게 마련해요 is not a valid expression for stating a general rule.

59e3de763e999b1b.zh: 「-다가는」接在動詞詞幹後，表示如果繼續做某事會引發嚴重的壞結果（出大事）。
59e3de763e999b1b.en: -다가는 attaches to a verb stem to warn that continuing to do something will lead to trouble.

59e3de763e999b1b.zh: 「-다가도」表示「就算……也……」或動作中途轉變，不能表示警告負面後果。
59e3de763e999b1b.en: -다가도 indicates an unexpected shift or even while doing, which does not fit the conditional warning meaning.

59e3de763e999b1b.zh: 「-하길래」表示理由或原因，不能用來表示假定後果的警告句。
59e3de763e999b1b.en: -하길래 gives a reason or cause based on fact, not a warning about hypothetical consequences.

59e3de763e999b1b.zh: 「-하고자」表示目的（為了……），不符合此句警告的語意。
59e3de763e999b1b.en: -하고자 indicates an aim or purpose, which does not fit the warning about playing games.

5a503fc35b8d8c84.zh: 形容詞꾸준한修飾노력이야말로，再接修飾방법이에요的子句실력을 키우는。
5a503fc35b8d8c84.en: 꾸준한 modifies 노력이야말로, followed by the relative clause 실력을 키우는 modifying 방법이에요.

5ae821588f6a0276.zh: 動詞接「-는 법이다」表示必然的常理，故「성공하다」接「는」。
5ae821588f6a0276.en: Verbs take -는 법이다 to state a natural truth or principle, giving 성공하는.
기 belongs to the pattern -기 마련이다 and does not pair with 법이다.

5ae821588f6a0276.zh: 「고」表示並列或連接，無法接「법이다」構成句型。
5ae821588f6a0276.en: 고 is a connective suffix and cannot modify the bound noun 법.
게 forms an adverbial clause and cannot modify the noun 법.

5b5c6f454321d6e0.zh: 副詞이렇게修飾動詞싸울，接바에야表「與其」，後接副詞차라리引出更好選擇。
5b5c6f454321d6e0.en: 이렇게 modifies 싸울; 싸울 takes 바에야 ('rather than'), followed naturally by 차라리 ('rather').

5b6dc454140da27b.zh: 時間短語「아침 여덟 시가」作主語，接「되어서야」（直到……才）修飾後文。
5b6dc454140da27b.en: Time phrase 아침 여덟 시가 acts as subject to 되어서야 (not until it became), leading to 일어났어요.

5bf6f8160c7d8c70.zh: 「-고자 하다」是固定句型，表示說話者的意圖或計畫「想要、打算」。
5bf6f8160c7d8c70.en: -고자 하다 is a set pattern used in formal contexts to express intention.

5bf6f8160c7d8c70.zh: 韓語中沒有「-고자 되다」的句型搭配。
5bf6f8160c7d8c70.en: -고자 되다 is not a grammatically valid pattern in Korean.

5bf6f8160c7d8c70.zh: 「-고자 있다」並非正確的語法搭配，表達意圖應使用「하다」。
5bf6f8160c7d8c70.en: -고자 있다 is not a valid collocation; intention requires 하다.

5bf6f8160c7d8c70.zh: 「-고자 보다」並非表示意圖的文法結構。
5bf6f8160c7d8c70.en: -고자 보다 is not a standard grammatical construction for intention.

5f3f38eee131a1d5.zh: 「도시는」為主語，形容詞「편리한」接「데 반해」形成對比。
5f3f38eee131a1d5.en: 도시는 is the subject, modified by 편리한, attaching directly to 데 반해.

607e0b6c47fcc566.zh: 動詞詞幹接「-다시피」，「보시다시피」表示「如您所見」。
607e0b6c47fcc566.en: -다시피 attaches directly to the stem; 보시다시피 means 'as you see'.

607e0b6c47fcc566.zh: 「-느라」表因為做某事導致負面結果，不符合「如您所見」的意思。
607e0b6c47fcc566.en: -느라 expresses a reason for a negative consequence, not 'as you see'.

607e0b6c47fcc566.zh: 「-더니」表示回想過去經歷並對比或轉折，與此處用法不同。
607e0b6c47fcc566.en: -더니 expresses past observation leading to a change or contrast, not 'as you see'.

607e0b6c47fcc566.zh: 「-다가」表示動作中斷或途中轉移，語意不合。
607e0b6c47fcc566.en: -다가 indicates an interruption or transition between actions, which doesn't fit.

6120e15ba9c919a0.zh: 「듣는 둥 마는 둥 하며」符合句型，並用「-며」連接「邊…邊做另一件事」。
6120e15ba9c919a0.en: 듣는 둥 마는 둥 하며 correctly applies the pattern and uses -며 to connect simultaneous actions.

6120e15ba9c919a0.zh: 「-러」表示目的（為了去做…），與後面「只看手機」的語境不符。
6120e15ba9c919a0.en: -러 expresses purpose (in order to), which makes no sense before 휴대폰만 봤다.

6120e15ba9c919a0.zh: 句型必須用冠形詞形「듣는」，不能用名詞形「듣기」。
6120e15ba9c919a0.en: The pattern requires the attributive form 듣는, not the nominalized 듣기.

6120e15ba9c919a0.zh: 慣用語固定使用「마는 둥」表示否定對照，不能用「안 듣는 둥」。
6120e15ba9c919a0.en: The idiom requires the contrasting auxiliary 마는 둥, not 안 듣는 둥.

6132e3256c82d5bc.zh: 「형은」作主詞，「말이 많은 데」修飾「데」表對比。
6132e3256c82d5bc.en: 형은 is the topic, followed by the clause 말이 많은 modifying 데 before 반해.

64760ee99dfa3e5e.zh: 句型為「-(으)ㄹ 바에야」，無收音的動詞詞幹「포기하-」接「ㄹ」。
64760ee99dfa3e5e.en: The pattern is -(으)ㄹ 바에야; 포기하- ends in a vowel, taking -ㄹ to become 할.

64760ee99dfa3e5e.zh: 「하는」是現在式冠形詞形，此句型固定使用未來式形態「-(으)ㄹ」。
64760ee99dfa3e5e.en: 하는 is the present modifier; the grammar requires prospective -(으)ㄹ with 바에야.

64760ee99dfa3e5e.zh: 「한」是過去式冠形詞形，不能接在「바에야」句型中。
64760ee99dfa3e5e.en: 한 is the past modifier, which does not attach to 바에야 for this grammar pattern.

64760ee99dfa3e5e.zh: 「해서」是連接詞尾，不能修飾依存名詞「바」。
64760ee99dfa3e5e.en: 해서 is a clausal connective and cannot modify the dependent noun 바.

64cf41178cce1a57.zh: 受詞「회사를」接動詞「그만두는」，再接慣用語「한이 있더라도」。
64cf41178cce1a57.en: 회사를 objects to the verb 그만두는, which completes the pattern with 한이 있더라도.

66ac859cf955eae4.zh: 動詞「듣다」為ㄷ不規則動詞，遇到母音時ㄷ變為ㄹ，故為「들어서야」。
66ac859cf955eae4.en: 듣다 is a ㄷ-irregular verb; ㄷ changes to ㄹ before a vowel, becoming 들어서야.

66ac859cf955eae4.zh: 「듣다」為ㄷ不規則動詞，接母音時不能維持「듣어서야」。
66ac859cf955eae4.en: 듣다 is ㄷ-irregular, so ㄷ cannot remain unchanged before a vowel ending.

66ac859cf955eae4.zh: 連接詞尾是「-어서야」而非「-으서야」，此變形規則錯誤。
66ac859cf955eae4.en: The ending is -어서야, not -으서야, making 들으서야 morphologically incorrect.

66ac859cf955eae4.zh: 「-어서야」必須包含母音「-어-」，不可直接接成「듣서야」。
66ac859cf955eae4.en: The connective requires the vowel -어-, so dropping it to 듣서야 is incorrect.

68363b0440e5c2f1.zh: 「-는 법이 없다」為固定慣用語，表示「絕不可能、從來不」。
68363b0440e5c2f1.en: -는 법이 없다 is a set grammar pattern meaning never or there is no way.

68363b0440e5c2f1.zh: 「마련이다」一般不與否定詞「없다」構成慣用句型。
68363b0440e5c2f1.en: 마련 is used in -기 마련이다 and does not pair with 없다 like this.

68363b0440e5c2f1.zh: 「나름」表示「取決於…」，搭配「-기 나름이다」，不符句意。
68363b0440e5c2f1.en: 나름 means depending on and forms -기 나름이다, not fitting this context.

68363b0440e5c2f1.zh: 「따름」表示「只是…」，句型為「-(으)ㄹ 따름이다」，不合文法。
68363b0440e5c2f1.en: 따름 means only/just and pairs with -(으)ㄹ 따름이다, not -는 ... 없다.

6898412b5a0abc9f.zh: 冠詞그修飾사람이야말로構成主語，再接形容詞진정한修飾謂語영웅이에요。
6898412b5a0abc9f.en: 그 modifies 사람이야말로 as the subject, followed by modifier 진정한 describing predicate 영웅이에요.

68d4b13e46ae67f6.zh: 動詞「굶다」後面接「는 한이 있더라도」表示「即使挨餓也…」。
68d4b13e46ae67f6.en: The verb 굶다 combines with 는 to form the pattern 굶는 한이 있더라도.

68d4b13e46ae67f6.zh: 動詞不能接「은」來構成「한이 있더라도」句型。
68d4b13e46ae67f6.en: Verbs do not take 은 to form the pattern -는 한이 있더라도.

68d4b13e46ae67f6.zh: 「을」表示推測或未來，此慣用句型必須用現在形「는」。
68d4b13e46ae67f6.en: 을 denotes future or prospective aspect, but this pattern requires 는.

68d4b13e46ae67f6.zh: 「던」表示過去回想，不能用於表達未來的強烈決心。
68d4b13e46ae67f6.en: 던 expresses past recollection and cannot be used for future determination.

68dca0e37ee8af0c.zh: 表示「很容易／容易發生壞事」的固定句型為「-기 십상이다」。
68dca0e37ee8af0c.en: The pattern expressing easily prone to a bad result is -기 십상이다.

68dca0e37ee8af0c.zh: 「-는」為定語詞尾，該句型必須接名詞化詞尾「-기」。
68dca0e37ee8af0c.en: -는 is an adnominal ending; the pattern requires nominalizer -기.

68dca0e37ee8af0c.zh: 「-게」為副詞形詞尾，不能與「십상이다」搭配使用。
68dca0e37ee8af0c.en: -게 makes an adverbial form and cannot precede 십상이다.

68dca0e37ee8af0c.zh: 「-고」表示並列或順序，不能與「십상이다」連用。
68dca0e37ee8af0c.en: -고 connects verbs and does not combine with 십상이다.

6952224a38785219.zh: 主語「그녀는」接賓語「힘든 훈련을」，再接動詞「견뎌」與後方「냈어요」結合。
6952224a38785219.en: Subject 그녀는 is followed by object phrase 힘든 훈련을 and verb 견뎌, completing 견뎌 냈어요.

6c8f69b87e063f32.zh: 「-다가는」接在動詞詞幹後，表示照這樣持續下去會有壞結果（錢會用光）。
6c8f69b87e063f32.en: -다가는 attaches to a verb stem to warn that continuing this action will lead to a bad outcome (running out of money).

6c8f69b87e063f32.zh: 「-느라고」表示因為做前事而導致後面的負面結果，用於已發生的事實，不用於預測未來。
6c8f69b87e063f32.en: -느라고 expresses a reason for a past negative result due to an ongoing action, not a future warning.

6c8f69b87e063f32.zh: 「-길래」表示原因或理由，通常根據已發生的觀察事實，不合句意。
6c8f69b87e063f32.en: -길래 indicates a reason based on observation or fact, not a conditional warning about the future.

6c8f69b87e063f32.zh: 「-고자」表示意圖或目的（為了……），此處並非想要讓錢用光，故不合。
6c8f69b87e063f32.en: -고자 indicates purpose or intention, which does not make sense here since running out of money is not an intended goal.

6d1e3d8524a702ac.zh: 「-아/어 내다」表示克服困難做到某事，過去式為「-어 냈어요」。
6d1e3d8524a702ac.en: -아/어 내다 expresses overcoming a hardship through effort; the past polite form is 냈어요.

6d1e3d8524a702ac.zh: 「났다」是「나다」（發生、長出）的過去式，並非表示克服的輔助動詞。
6d1e3d8524a702ac.en: 났어요 is from 나다 (to happen/occur), not the auxiliary verb used to express overcoming.

6d1e3d8524a702ac.zh: 「넣었어요」是「넣다」（放入）的過去式，意思完全不符合語境。
6d1e3d8524a702ac.en: 넣었어요 means put into from 넣다, which makes no sense here.

6d1e3d8524a702ac.zh: 「놨어요」是「놓다」（放下）的過去式，表示保持某狀態，非克服困難。
6d1e3d8524a702ac.en: 놨어요 is from 놓다, meaning to leave something in a state, not to overcome.

6d8b3c2432ebd645.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 만도 하다」句型的結尾動詞固定使用「하다」。
6d8b3c2432ebd645.en: The set expression is -(으)ㄹ 만도 하다, requiring the verb 하다.

6d8b3c2432ebd645.zh: 句型固定為「-(으)ㄹ 만도 하다」，不能搭配「있다」。
6d8b3c2432ebd645.en: The pattern is strictly formed with 하다, not 있다.

6d8b3c2432ebd645.zh: 句型固定為「-(으)ㄹ 만도 하다」，不能搭配「되다」。
6d8b3c2432ebd645.en: The construction uses 하다; 되네요 does not fit this idiom.

6d8b3c2432ebd645.zh: 「오다」意為「來」，不能與「-(으)ㄹ 만도」搭配構成該語法。
6d8b3c2432ebd645.en: 오다 means to come and cannot form the idiom -(으)ㄹ 만도 하다.

6eb8db1d36ffad49.zh: 「제가 보기에」是固定慣用語，表示「依我看、在我看來」。
6eb8db1d36ffad49.en: 제가 보기에 is a set phrase meaning in my view or as I see it.

6eb8db1d36ffad49.zh: 「보기로」常用於「보기로 하다」（決定看），不符合此處表達觀點的語意。
6eb8db1d36ffad49.en: 보기로 typically pairs with 하다 to mean decide to see, which does not fit.

6eb8db1d36ffad49.zh: 「보기만」表示「光是看、只看」，無法接續後方表達個人觀點。
6eb8db1d36ffad49.en: 보기만 means only looking, which does not express in my view.
보기도 means also looking or sometimes seeing, not expressing an opinion.

6f59a26ab54a32a8.zh: 主語「가족들이」接謂語「지켜보는」，連成「가운데」背景子句，最後引出主句主語「그는」。
6f59a26ab54a32a8.en: 가족들이 subjects 지켜보는, forming the background clause with 가운데, followed by the main subject 그는.

707b1ccb625aa232.en: 조르다 is an irregular 르-verb that conjugates to 졸라 before 대다.

707b1ccb625aa232.zh: 「조르다」為르不規則活用，不可規則變化成「조르어」。
707b1ccb625aa232.en: 조르다 follows the irregular 르-conjugation, so 조르어 댔어요 is incorrect.

707b1ccb625aa232.zh: 補助動詞是「대다」而非「되다」，拼寫「됐어요」錯誤。
707b1ccb625aa232.en: The auxiliary verb is 대다, so spelling it with 되 (됐어요) is incorrect.

707b1ccb625aa232.zh: 「대야어요」為錯誤的過去式形態，正確過去式為「댔어요」。
707b1ccb625aa232.en: 대야어요 is an invalid conjugation; the past tense form is 댔어요.

712e32803ac1aa7f.zh: 「-다가는」表示如果持續做某事將帶來不良後果，接「건강을 해칠 거예요」（會傷身體）最符合情境。
712e32803ac1aa7f.en: -다가는 warns that an action will lead to a bad result, which matches 건강을 해칠 거예요 (will harm your health).

712e32803ac1aa7f.zh: 「건강해질 거예요」表示會變健康，與「-다가는」警告負面後果的用法相反。
712e32803ac1aa7f.en: 건강해질 거예요 means will become healthy, which contradicts the negative outcome warning required after -다가는.

712e32803ac1aa7f.zh: 「건강했어요」是過去肯定句，無法配合表示未來可能發生壞結果的「-다가는」。
712e32803ac1aa7f.en: 건강했어요 is past tense, which cannot express the warned future consequence required by -다가는.

712e32803ac1aa7f.zh: 「건강을 지켰어요」是過去式「保持了健康」，語意與時態皆與「-다가는」的警告不符。
712e32803ac1aa7f.en: 건강을 지켰어요 means kept healthy in past tense, contradicting the negative future warning of -다가는.

728090d1035c09d3.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 만도 하다」為固定句型，表示「理所當然、難怪會…」。
728090d1035c09d3.en: The pattern -(으)ㄹ 만도 하다 expresses that a reaction is natural or understandable.

728090d1035c09d3.zh: 「만큼」表示程度或相當於，後續接「하다」無法表達理應如此的含義。
728090d1035c09d3.en: 만큼 expresses degree or comparison, which does not fit the intended meaning of no wonder.

728090d1035c09d3.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 뿐이다」表示「只是、僅僅」，不能接「-도 해요」。
728090d1035c09d3.en: -(으)ㄹ 뿐이다 means only or merely, and it does not form a natural pattern here.

728090d1035c09d3.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 줄 알다/모르다」表示知道或以為，不接「-도 해요」。
728090d1035c09d3.en: -(으)ㄹ 줄 is paired with verbs like 알다 or 모르다, not -도 하다.

72f941c4b7d17917.zh: 「여름치고는」表示就夏天的標準而言出乎意料，後接「很涼爽」。
72f941c4b7d17917.en: 여름치고는 sets an expectation, followed by an unexpected trait: 시원하네요.

72f941c4b7d17917.zh: 「여름이라서 덥네요」是一般因果關係，無法配合「치고는」的反差意。
72f941c4b7d17917.en: 여름이라서 덥네요 shows expected causality, conflicting with 치고는's contrast.

72f941c4b7d17917.zh: 「당연히 더워요」表示理所當然很熱，與「치고는」表意外的用法相反。
72f941c4b7d17917.en: 당연히 더워요 expresses natural expectation, which contradicts 치고는.

72f941c4b7d17917.zh: 「여름 같아요」表示像夏天，無法展現出相較於一般夏天的例外情況。
72f941c4b7d17917.en: 여름 같아요 means it feels like summer, which does not match 치고는.

742ed4633ba16387.zh: 句型「N에 불과하다」固定接助詞「에」，表示「只不過是…」。
742ed4633ba16387.en: The grammar pattern N에 불과하다 strictly takes the particle 에.

742ed4633ba16387.zh: 主格助詞「이」不能與「불과하다」搭配構成此固定句型。
742ed4633ba16387.en: The subject marker 이 cannot pair with 불과하다 in this pattern.

742ed4633ba16387.zh: 表示工具或手段的助詞「으로」不符合此句型的固定用法。
742ed4633ba16387.en: 으로 indicates method or direction, which does not fit N에 불과하다.

742ed4633ba16387.zh: 表示「和/與」的助詞「과」無法與「불과하다」搭配表達「僅僅是」。
742ed4633ba16387.en: The comitative particle 과 (with/and) does not fit this construction.

754f998fce023109.zh: 「-고자」表示做某事的意圖或目的，意為「為了獲得獎學金」。
754f998fce023109.en: -고자 expresses the intention or purpose of an action: in order to receive a scholarship.

754f998fce023109.zh: 「-거나」表示二選一的「或者」，無法表達努力讀書的目的。
754f998fce023109.en: -거나 expresses an alternative (or), not a purpose for studying.

754f998fce023109.zh: 「-든지」表示無論如何、任選其一，語意不合。
754f998fce023109.en: -든지 expresses regardless of whether or choice, not purpose.

754f998fce023109.zh: 「-는지」用於間接疑問句，不能用於連接目的與行動。
754f998fce023109.en: -는지 marks an indirect question clause and cannot express purpose.

76f2d71d1ae4c8ab.zh: 「-다길래」是間接引語「-다고 하길래」的縮略形，表示「聽說……所以就……」。
76f2d71d1ae4c8ab.en: 다길래 is the contraction of the indirect quote form -다고 하길래, meaning having heard that...

76f2d71d1ae4c8ab.zh: 「다고서」並非正確的韓語文法連接詞尾形式。
76f2d71d1ae4c8ab.en: 다고서 is not a grammatically valid connective ending in Korean.

76f2d71d1ae4c8ab.zh: 「다더라도」表示「即使聽說……也」，與後面買藥去探望的順接因果不符。
76f2d71d1ae4c8ab.en: 다더라도 means even if it is said that, which illogically contradicts the caring reaction.

76f2d71d1ae4c8ab.zh: 「다느라」並非正確的結合形式，表示原因的「느라」前面不能這樣接間接引語。
76f2d71d1ae4c8ab.en: 다느라 is ungrammatical; the causal ending 느라 cannot attach to indirect citation like this.

78152592e3d61866.zh: 承接前句「-어서야」的假設批評，搭配「어떻게 …겠어요」構成反問句。
78152592e3d61866.en: Forms a rhetorical question with 어떻게 …겠어요 to match the critical condition in -어서야.

78152592e3d61866.zh: 「같이 잘 살았어요」是陳述過去過得很好，與前半句的批評嚴重矛盾。
78152592e3d61866.en: This means lived together well in the past, directly contradicting the premise of fighting.

78152592e3d61866.zh: 「같이 사니까요」表示「因為一起生活」，無法合理承接前半句「如此吵架的話」。
78152592e3d61866.en: This means because we live together, which does not naturally complete the conditional criticism.

78152592e3d61866.zh: 「같이 살게요」表示承諾「我會一起生活的」，與前面抱怨爭吵的語氣不符。
78152592e3d61866.en: This expresses an intention or promise to live together, not fitting the complaining tone.

7888207981cbc7e8.zh: 「-어서야 어떻게 -(으)겠어요?」是反問結構，表示「怎能獲勝」。
7888207981cbc7e8.en: Matches the rhetorical question pattern with -어서야 어떻게: how could you possibly win?

7888207981cbc7e8.zh: 「이겼어요」是過去肯定句，不能與反問副詞「어떻게」直接形成反問句尾。
7888207981cbc7e8.en: This is a simple past statement, won, which does not fit the rhetorical question with 어떻게.

7888207981cbc7e8.zh: 「이기고 있어요」是現在進行式「正在贏」，無法與「어떻게」形成反問意涵。
7888207981cbc7e8.en: This is present progressive, am winning, which does not form a rhetorical question with 어떻게.

7888207981cbc7e8.zh: 「이길게요」表示第一人稱承諾「我會贏的」，不能用於質疑對方的反問句。
7888207981cbc7e8.en: This expresses a personal commitment, I will win, not a question addressing someone else.

78d67e391cdb4d6e.zh: 「되-」接「-고서야」表示「直到成為……之後才」，符合句意。
78d67e391cdb4d6e.en: 되- combines with -고서야 to mean only after becoming, which fits the sentence.

78d67e391cdb4d6e.zh: 「길래」表示原因或根據「因為/既然」，無法表達「直到……才」的體會。
78d67e391cdb4d6e.en: 길래 expresses a reason or ground (because/since), not the realization only after becoming.

78d67e391cdb4d6e.zh: 「느라」表示因某動作而產生負面結果，不適合接在自動詞「되다」後。
78d67e391cdb4d6e.en: 느라 indicates a negative result caused by doing an action, which does not fit 되다 here.

78d67e391cdb4d6e.zh: 「도록」表示「達到……的程度」或「以便」，無法表達事後才體會的文意。
78d67e391cdb4d6e.en: 도록 expresses degree or purpose (so that/until), not an insight gained only after.

78ddaf5b4ff43bfd.en: 한번 modifies 시작한, which attaches to 이상, leading into the adverb 끝까지.

7acc3ffcb81d134c.zh: 語幹以ㄹ結尾的「살다」直接加「-지언정」，表達寧貧窮也不說謊。
7acc3ffcb81d134c.en: 살다 has a stem ending in ㄹ and attaches directly to -지언정 to express resolve.

7acc3ffcb81d134c.zh: 「사는지언정」形式錯誤，此文法應接於詞幹後成「살지언정」。
7acc3ffcb81d134c.en: 사는지언정 is incorrect; the pattern attaches directly to verb stems as 살지언정.

7acc3ffcb81d134c.zh: 「살길래」表示原因或根據，意思是「因為生活」，與後句語意不通。
7acc3ffcb81d134c.en: 살길래 indicates a reason or cause (because I live), which does not make sense here.

7acc3ffcb81d134c.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ수록」表示越…越…，意思是「越生活越…」，語意不符。
7acc3ffcb81d134c.en: 살수록 means the more one lives, expressing proportional increase rather than resolve.

7be7bb4a33c2f45c.zh: 主詞그는接副詞거의，修飾句型굶다시피 하면서，表示「幾乎挨餓著」。
7be7bb4a33c2f45c.en: Subject 그는 is followed by adverb 거의, modifying the connective phrase 굶다시피 하면서 ('practically starving').

7c17ef53ff12e6e8.zh: 「뿌린 대로」修飾動詞「거두는」，再接表示自然常理的「법이에요」。
7c17ef53ff12e6e8.en: 뿌린 대로 modifies 거두는, which naturally combines with 법이에요 to express a natural law.

7c997299eccc1889.zh: 「-ㄴ 데 반해」表示前後兩件事實形成相反對比。
7c997299eccc1889.en: 데 반해 completes the pattern contrasting two opposing situations: exports rose, whereas imports fell.

7c997299eccc1889.zh: 「따라」接在「-에」後表示「隨著」，但與「데」無法構成該對比句型。
7c997299eccc1889.en: 따라 means following or along with, not expressing contrast after 데.

7c997299eccc1889.zh: 「대해」表示「關於」或「針對」，無法在此表達反差對比。
7c997299eccc1889.en: 대해 means regarding or about, which cannot form a contrast here.

7c997299eccc1889.zh: 「관해」表示「有關」，與「데」連用無法表示對比關係。
7c997299eccc1889.en: 관해 means concerning or related to, not serving as a contrast marker.

7ce138061fd759f8.zh: 主詞「이번 실패는」後接名詞片語「작은 실수에」，與後方的「불과합니다」結合。
7ce138061fd759f8.en: Subject 이번 실패는 leads to the noun phrase 작은 실수에, which correctly completes the predicate with 불과합니다.

7cf1b3287c136ffa.zh: 「-느니」表「與其…不如…」，接在動詞「하-」後，與「나아요」呼應。
7cf1b3287c136ffa.en: -느니 attaches to the verb stem 하- to mean 'rather than', matching 나아요.

7cf1b3287c136ffa.zh: 「더니」表回想過去經歷並對比或引出結果，語義不合。
7cf1b3287c136ffa.en: 더니 recalls a past observation to express contrast or result, not preference.

7cf1b3287c136ffa.zh: 「거든」表條件「如果…的話」，在此句中無法表達取捨之意。
7cf1b3287c136ffa.en: 거든 means 'if/when' in conditions, which does not fit this comparative meaning.

7cf1b3287c136ffa.zh: 「도록」表目的或程度（為了、到…程度），語義不符。
7cf1b3287c136ffa.en: 도록 indicates a degree, goal, or purpose, which does not fit.

81c042d894ca76a3.zh: 「-했길래」用於過去事態作為疑問句中引發強烈結果的原因，句型為「무슨 말을 했길래」。
81c042d894ca76a3.en: 했길래 indicates a past trigger in a question asking what happened to cause such a reaction.

81c042d894ca76a3.zh: 「했느라」文法錯誤，「-느라(고)」不能接在過去時制標記「-았/었-」之後。
81c042d894ca76a3.en: 했느라 is ungrammatical because the causal ending -느라 cannot follow past tense -았/었-.

81c042d894ca76a3.zh: 「하길래서」是錯誤的形式，連接詞尾「길래」後面不能再加「-서」。
81c042d894ca76a3.en: 하길래서 is incorrect; the connective ending 길래 cannot be combined with 서.

81c042d894ca76a3.zh: 「했도록」不自然，「-도록」表示程度或目的，通常不接在過去時制後面。
81c042d894ca76a3.en: 했도록 is awkward and incorrect because -도록 typically does not combine with past tense.

81f7cc8f69157ebc.zh: 副詞「그렇게 쉽게」修飾「포기해서야」，再接反問副詞「어떻게」引導疑問。
81f7cc8f69157ebc.en: Adverbs 그렇게 쉽게 modify 포기해서야 (if you give up like that), followed by 어떻게 for the rhetorical question.

833a439269977f8e.zh: 副詞「너무」修飾原因「긴장해서」，後接慣用語「자는 둥 마는 둥」。
833a439269977f8e.en: 너무 modifies the cause 긴장해서, which leads into the pattern 자는 둥 마는 둥.

846f3386bd595568.zh: 名詞搭配助詞「에」與「불과하다」構成「只不過是…」，過去式為「에 불과했다」。
846f3386bd595568.en: N에 불과하다 means nothing more than N, and 에 불과했다 is its natural past tense.

846f3386bd595568.zh: 此句型固定搭配助詞「에」，不能使用主格助詞「이」。
846f3386bd595568.en: This pattern requires the particle 에, not the subject marker 이.

846f3386bd595568.zh: 「불과하다」是形容詞，不能接現在式動詞終結字尾「-는 Rosalind/는다」。
846f3386bd595568.en: 불과하다 functions as an adjective, so it cannot take the dynamic ending -는다.

846f3386bd595568.zh: 此句型固定搭配助詞「에」，不能使用受格助詞「을」。
846f3386bd595568.en: The pattern requires the particle 에; the object marker 을 is grammatically incorrect.

873a37e555843db8.zh: 主詞「그는」接受詞「모든 것을」，再接「잃고서야」（失去後才），邏輯通順。
873a37e555843db8.en: Subject 그는 precedes object 모든 것을, followed by 잃고서야 (only after losing) before 정신을 차렸다.

876b0b471689eb3a.zh: 「있다」習慣上接動詞冠詞形「-는」，形成「있는 법이다」。
876b0b471689eb3a.en: 있다 takes the modifier suffix -는, forming 있는 법이다 to express a universal rule.

876b0b471689eb3a.zh: 「있다」不接形容詞用的「-은」，文法形態錯誤。
876b0b471689eb3a.en: 있다 takes -는, not the adjective modifier -은.
기 belongs with 마련이다, not with the noun 법.

876b0b471689eb3a.zh: 「게」是副詞形，無法作為修飾語修飾依賴名詞「법」。
876b0b471689eb3a.en: 게 creates an adverbial clause, so it cannot qualify the noun 법.

8796fe23c3f9aaa4.zh: 動詞「만들다」詞幹接「-기」構成「-기 나름이다」，表「取決於怎麼做」。
8796fe23c3f9aaa4.en: Verb stem 만들- combines with -기 to form the pattern -기 나름이다.

8796fe23c3f9aaa4.zh: 「-는」是定語詞尾，與「나름이다」搭配時需用名詞化詞尾「-기」。
8796fe23c3f9aaa4.en: -는 is an adnominal ending; the pattern requires nominalizer -기.

8796fe23c3f9aaa4.zh: 「-어」是用於連接或結尾的詞尾，不能搭配「나름이다」。
8796fe23c3f9aaa4.en: -어 is an informal connective/ending and cannot connect to 나름이다.

8796fe23c3f9aaa4.zh: 「-고」表示並列，無法與「나름이다」連用表示取決於。
8796fe23c3f9aaa4.en: -고 indicates sequence or listing and cannot combine with 나름이다.

89a1f39100774c8e.zh: 主語「케이크가」接視覺判斷「맛있어 보이길래」表理由，後接賓語數量詞「하나」。
89a1f39100774c8e.en: 케이크가 combines with 맛있어 보이길래 to express the observed reason, connecting to the numeral 하나 before 사 왔어요.

89a224f017aeb730.zh: 與後方「선물을 주든지」呼應，用「-든지」列舉道歉或送禮。
89a224f017aeb730.en: -든지 forms the parallel pair with 주든지 to list possible actions.

89a224f017aeb730.zh: 「-던지」是回憶過去事實的語尾，無法用來列舉解決方案。
89a224f017aeb730.en: -던지 relates to recalling past situations, not presenting alternative actions.

89a224f017aeb730.zh: 「-더니」表示回想過去經歷並接續轉折或結果，在此不適用。
89a224f017aeb730.en: -더니 connects a past observation with a subsequent result, not choices.

89a224f017aeb730.zh: 「-도록」表示達到某種目的或程度，無法與後方的「-든지」呼應。
89a224f017aeb730.en: -도록 indicates purpose or result, unable to pair with -든지.

89e65419a0bc511c.zh: 「-든지 -든지」用於列舉兩種狀況（下雨或下雪），結果不受影響。
89e65419a0bc511c.en: 오든지 pairs with 눈이 오든지 to express whether it rains or snows.

89e65419a0bc511c.zh: 「-던지」是回想過去感嘆或原因的語尾，不可用於假設或選擇。
89e65419a0bc511c.en: -던지 expresses retrospective wondering or causes, not alternative conditions.

89e65419a0bc511c.zh: 「-도록」表示為了達到某種目的或程度，在此語意不符。
89e65419a0bc511c.en: -도록 means in order to or to the extent that, not whether... or.

89e65419a0bc511c.zh: 「-느라(고)」表示因進行某動作而導致負面結果，不合句意。
89e65419a0bc511c.en: -느라 expresses a reason leading to a negative outcome, which doesn't fit.

8a6de30d844e6e8d.zh: 受詞「단것만」接警告條件「먹다가는」，後接壞結果主語「이가 다」。
8a6de30d844e6e8d.en: Object 단것만 attaches to the condition 먹다가는, followed by the subject 이가 and adverb 다 before the predicate.

8c9f4ddf8c66391c.zh: 「-았/었더라면 좋았을 텐데」為固定慣用句型，表示對過去未達成之事的後悔或惋惜。
8c9f4ddf8c66391c.en: -았/었더라면 paired with 좋았을 텐데 is a standard pattern expressing regret over a past unfulfilled action.

8c9f4ddf8c66391c.zh: 「듣더라면」缺少過去時制標記「-았/었-」，假設過去情況必須用「들었더라면」。
8c9f4ddf8c66391c.en: 듣더라면 lacks the past marker -었-, which is necessary to form the past counterfactual -았/었더라면.

8c9f4ddf8c66391c.zh: 「들었더니」表示「聽了之後發現……」，是敘述已發生的實際經驗，並非假設。
8c9f4ddf8c66391c.en: 들었더니 describes an actual past action and its observed result, not a counterfactual regret.

8c9f4ddf8c66391c.zh: 「들어서」表示原因或相繼動作，與後面表示惋惜的「좋았을 텐데」無法搭配成假設句。
8c9f4ddf8c66391c.en: 들어서 expresses cause or sequential action, which does not form the hypothetical regret structure with 좋았을 텐데.

8d1a7e415e479626.zh: 「지나서야」表示「（時間）過了之後才……」，符合「一小時後公車才來」。
8d1a7e415e479626.en: 지나서야 means not until (time) passed, fitting the meaning that the bus came an hour later.

8d1a7e415e479626.zh: 「지나느라」表示忙於度過時間而導致負面結果，不合句意。
8d1a7e415e479626.en: 지나느라 indicates a negative result due to an action, which does not make sense with passing time.

8d1a7e415e479626.zh: 「지나려고」表示意圖「為了過去/為了度過」，語意不合。
8d1a7e415e479626.en: 지나려고 means in order to pass, indicating purpose rather than time sequence.

8d1a7e415e479626.zh: 「지나자고」表示提議「一起度過吧」，文理不通。
8d1a7e415e479626.en: 지나자고 is a suggestive form meaning let's pass, which is nonsensical here.

8dd89276503bf16c.zh: 副詞「그저」修飾賓語動詞片語「최선을 다했을」，後接「따름입니다」。
8dd89276503bf16c.en: Adverb 그저 modifies 최선을 다했을, which attaches to 따름입니다 under the -(으)ㄹ 따름이다 pattern.

8e0ba02b45fb5b9c.zh: 「-는 통에」表示因混亂吵鬧的狀況帶來負面結果，接「정신이 하나도 없었어요」最合適。
8e0ba02b45fb5b9c.en: V-는 통에 introduces a chaotic cause leading to a negative result, perfectly matching 정신이 하나도 없었어요.

8e0ba02b45fb5b9c.zh: 「정신이 맑아졌어요」表示精神變清醒，與「-는 통에」帶來的混亂負面結果矛盾。
8e0ba02b45fb5b9c.en: 정신이 맑아졌어요 means one became clear-headed, which contradicts the chaotic negative outcome implied by -는 통에.

8e0ba02b45fb5b9c.zh: 「아주 한가했어요」表示非常清閒，與前句客人突然湧入的混亂狀況衝突。
8e0ba02b45fb5b9c.en: 아주 한가했어요 means one was very free, contradicting the chaotic rush of incoming customers.

8e0ba02b45fb5b9c.zh: 「푹 쉴 수 있었어요」表示得以好好休息，是正面結果，不符合「-는 통에」的語意。
8e0ba02b45fb5b9c.en: 푹 쉴 수 있었어요 means one could rest well, a positive outcome that clashes with -는 통에.

8e9e68250142ea17.zh: 冠形詞「그런」修飾「사람과」，接「일하느니」與副詞「차라리」形成取捨。
8e9e68250142ea17.en: 그런 modifies 사람과, followed by the verb 일하느니 and adverb 차라리 to state a preference.

8f2ff4f8c03f5b11.zh: 受詞「목숨을」接動詞「잃는」，組合為慣用句型「한이 있더라도」。
8f2ff4f8c03f5b11.en: 목숨을 is the object of 잃는, which attaches to the grammar 한이 있더라도.

92ad38391f4e808f.zh: 「-고자」用於正式場合表達目的，意為「為了致謝而站在這裡」。
92ad38391f4e808f.en: -고자 is a formal connector expressing purpose: standing here in order to express thanks.

92ad38391f4e808f.zh: 「-고서」表示動作的前後順序（做完…之後），不表目的。
92ad38391f4e808f.en: -고서 indicates temporal sequence (and then), not an intended purpose.

92ad38391f4e808f.zh: 「-거나」表示選擇「或者」，不符合句中表達目的的語意。
92ad38391f4e808f.en: -거나 means or, which does not fit the intended meaning of purpose.

92ad38391f4e808f.zh: 「-도록」雖可表目的，但在此正式演說語境中「-고자」更為標準自然。
92ad38391f4e808f.en: -도록 expresses so that / to the extent that, but -고자 is the standard formal marker here.

951cda36bf85973d.zh: 「名詞+치고는」表示以名牌的基準來看，價格偏便宜，帶有意外感。
951cda36bf85973d.en: 치고는 indicates that relative to being a luxury item, it is surprisingly cheap.

951cda36bf85973d.zh: 「만큼」表示程度相當，若選此項會變成「如名牌般便宜」，語意矛盾。
951cda36bf85973d.en: 만큼 means as much as, creating a contradiction with being cheap.

951cda36bf85973d.zh: 「이라서」表示原因，名牌通常昂貴，不能作為便宜的直接理由。
951cda36bf85973d.en: 이라서 means because, but being a luxury item is not a reason for being cheap.

951cda36bf85973d.zh: 「조차」表示「連…也」，無法用來作為衡量價格標準的依據。
951cda36bf85973d.en: 조차 means even, which cannot set a baseline of comparison.

9545ef22b1550152.zh: 動詞「말을 걸다」接表示混亂原因的句型「-는 통에」時，詞幹後應接「거는」。
9545ef22b1550152.en: The pattern -는 통에 attaches to the verb stem of 말을 걸다 as 거는 to express a disruptive cause.

9545ef22b1550152.zh: 「건」是過去時冠形詞形，此處文法固定搭配現在時冠形詞尾「-는 통에」。
9545ef22b1550152.en: 건 is the past modifier form; the grammatical pattern requires the present modifier form -는 통에.

9545ef22b1550152.zh: 「걸」是未來時冠形詞形，此處文法固定接「-는 통에」。
9545ef22b1550152.en: 걸 is the future modifier form; the pattern strictly takes -는 통에.

9545ef22b1550152.zh: 「걸어」是動詞的非格式體連接形，不能直接修飾依存名詞「통에」。
9545ef22b1550152.en: 걸어 is an informal connective form and cannot modify the bound noun 통에 directly.

95f0285d0d910e36.zh: 「既然已決定」理應引出相應的責任「只能全力以赴」。
95f0285d0d910e36.en: Following 'now that it is decided', 최선을 다할 수밖에 없어요 expresses the natural resulting duty.

95f0285d0d910e36.zh: 「尚未決定」與前句「이미 결정한」(已決定)前後矛盾。
95f0285d0d910e36.en: 아직 정하지 않았어요 contradicts the preceding 이미 결정한.

95f0285d0d910e36.zh: 「決定很困難」是過去感受，無法構成後續必然的結果。
95f0285d0d910e36.en: 결정이 어려웠어요 states past difficulty rather than a resulting resolution.

95f0285d0d910e36.zh: 「不知道是否會決定」與既成事實「已決定」相互矛盾。
95f0285d0d910e36.en: 결정할지 모르겠어요 expresses uncertainty, contradicting that it has already been decided.

969a17d93ecd989d.zh: 「둥 하고」完整接續了「하는 둥 마는 둥 하다」，連接後面的外出行動。
969a17d93ecd989d.en: 둥 하고 correctly completes the expression -는 둥 마는 둥 하고 before the main verb.

969a17d93ecd989d.zh: 「둥이고」是名詞接「-이고」，在此不能流暢連接後續動詞「외출했어요」。
969a17d93ecd989d.en: 둥이고 attaches the copula -이다, which cannot naturally link to the verb 외출했어요.

969a17d93ecd989d.zh: 「마는 척하고」改變了句型，前半部「하는 둥」會變得殘缺不全。
969a17d93ecd989d.en: 척하고 clashes with the preceding 하는 둥, leaving the first clause ungrammatical.

969a17d93ecd989d.zh: 「마는 김에」文法錯誤，且「-는 김에」無法承接前面的「하는 둥」。
969a17d93ecd989d.en: 김에 cannot attach to 마는, and it does not complete the 하는 둥 pattern.

9708b6bbd163ad2a.zh: 「-느니」直接接在動詞詞幹後（먹+느니），表示「與其…不如…」。
9708b6bbd163ad2a.en: The ending -느니 attaches directly to the verb stem 먹- regardless of batchim.

9708b6bbd163ad2a.zh: 韓語中沒有「는니」這種文法形態。
9708b6bbd163ad2a.en: The form 는니 does not exist in standard Korean grammar.

9708b6bbd163ad2a.zh: 「으니」表原因或發現，且此句型固定為「-느니」，非「-으니」。
9708b6bbd163ad2a.en: 으니 expresses cause or realization, not the preference pattern -느니.

9708b6bbd163ad2a.zh: 「거니」用於推測或固定句型（如 -려니/-거니），不表取捨。
9708b6bbd163ad2a.en: 거니 expresses supposition or habitual repetition, not preference over an alternative.

981d504c9588d1b9.zh: 主語「아이가」後接賓語「장난감을」，「사 달라고」修飾後方「졸라 댔어요」。
981d504c9588d1b9.en: Subject 아이가 takes object 장난감을, followed by quotation 사 달라고 modifying 졸라 댔어요.

9869296f2e0b5608.zh: 「-기에」表原因時，後句只能接陳述句，不能接命令句或共動句。
9869296f2e0b5608.en: When -기에 gives a reason, the clause must end in a declarative statement.

9869296f2e0b5608.zh: 「-자」為共動句（提議），「-기에」後句不能使用共動形。
9869296f2e0b5608.en: -자 is a suggestion; clauses following -기에 cannot end in a propositive.

9869296f2e0b5608.zh: 「-(으)세요」為命令句（請求），「-기에」後句不能使用命令形。
9869296f2e0b5608.en: -(으)세요 is an imperative; clauses following -기에 cannot end in an imperative.

9869296f2e0b5608.zh: 「-(으)ㅂ시다」為共動句（提議），「-기에」後句不可接提議句式。
9869296f2e0b5608.en: -(으)ㅂ시다 is propositive; clauses following -기에 cannot end in a suggestion.

9a2ba7dc9d52d19d.zh: 後句搭配「-겠습니다」表達說話者即便遭受責難也要揭露的決心。
9a2ba7dc9d52d19d.en: 밝히겠습니다 conveys the speaker's firm resolve, matching the pattern.

9a2ba7dc9d52d19d.zh: 「밝혔습니다」是過去式陳述，無法表達後續要採取的堅定意志。
9a2ba7dc9d52d19d.en: 밝혔습니다 is past tense, which cannot express a future resolve.

9a2ba7dc9d52d19d.zh: 「밝히고 있습니다」表示正在進行，不適合表達孤注一擲的決心。
9a2ba7dc9d52d19d.en: 밝히고 있습니다 describes an ongoing action rather than a resolute commitment.

9a2ba7dc9d52d19d.zh: 「밝히는지 몰라요」表示不知道是否揭露，語意與前句決心矛盾。
9a2ba7dc9d52d19d.en: 밝히는지 몰라요 expresses uncertainty, contradicting the firm resolve.

9c0fc509794d3193.zh: 處所主語「윗집에서」引導動詞「쿵쿵거리는」，接「통에」表原因，後接賓語「잠을」。
9c0fc509794d3193.en: 윗집에서 forms the subject location for 쿵쿵거리는 통에, giving the cause for the object 잠을 before 설쳤어요.

9c3016be898aef7c.zh: 語法「-(으)ㄹ 만도 하다」需接未來時態冠詞形，「나다」接「-ㄹ」成「날」。
9c3016be898aef7c.en: The pattern -(으)ㄹ 만도 하다 requires the -(으)ㄹ noun-modifying ending, so 날 is correct.

9c3016be898aef7c.zh: 「-는」是現在時態冠詞形，不能與「만도 하다」搭配。
9c3016be898aef7c.en: -는 is the present adnominal ending and cannot pair with 만도 하다.

9c3016be898aef7c.zh: 「-ㄴ」是過去時態冠詞形，不能與「만도 하다」搭配。
9c3016be898aef7c.en: -ㄴ is a past adnominal form and cannot connect to 만도 하다.

9c3016be898aef7c.zh: 「-아서/어서」表示原因或順序的連接詞尾，不能修飾依存名詞「만」。
9c3016be898aef7c.en: -아서/어서 is a connective suffix showing cause and cannot modify the bound noun 만.

9caff41591d7978c.zh: 「-고서야」表示「只有在…之後才…」，「겪다」接「-고서야」完全符合句意。
9caff41591d7978c.en: -고서야 means only after doing something, which fits the meaning of only after experiencing it.

9caff41591d7978c.zh: 「-느라(고)」表示因為做某事而導致後面的負面結果，不合句意。
9caff41591d7978c.en: -느라 expresses that doing an action caused a negative result, not fitting this context.

9caff41591d7978c.zh: 「-도록」表示達到某種程度或為了某目的，無法表示「親身經歷之後才」。
9caff41591d7978c.en: -도록 expresses extent or purpose (so that), not only after doing something.

9caff41591d7978c.zh: 「-자고」為共動句（提議）的引用詞尾或表示目的，無法表達親歷後才理解。
9caff41591d7978c.en: -자고 is a propositive quoting ending or indicates intention, not only after.

9edf973015157d6e.zh: 主語「시간이」後接對立項「있든지 없든지」，再以副詞「꼭」修飾後文。
9edf973015157d6e.en: Subject 시간이 connects to the opposing pair 있든지 없든지, and 꼭 modifies the final predicate 와야 해요.

9fb4794c7b1fd0dc.zh: 與過去相反的假設句「-았/었더라면」後半句常接「-(으)ㄹ 뻔했다」，表示「差點就做了某事」。
9fb4794c7b1fd0dc.en: Past counterfactual clauses with -았/었더라면 frequently conclude with -(으)ㄹ 뻔했다 (almost did something).

9fb4794c7b1fd0dc.zh: 「했어」是過去確定發生的事實（犯錯了），但實際上因被阻止而沒有犯錯，故語意不符。
9fb4794c7b1fd0dc.en: 했어 states that the mistake actually happened, contradicting the fact that the speaker was stopped.

9fb4794c7b1fd0dc.zh: 「하고 있어」是現在進行式，不能用於回顧過去險些發生的情境。
9fb4794c7b1fd0dc.en: 하고 있어 is present continuous, which cannot describe a near-miss event in the past.

9fb4794c7b1fd0dc.zh: 「할 거야」是未來意志或推測，與前半句假設過去的時態不符。
9fb4794c7b1fd0dc.en: 할 거야 indicates future intent or prediction, which does not match a past counterfactual situation.

a2aafe52f748c818.zh: 「-길래」用於口語，表示看到或得知某情況後採取相應行動，符合語境。
a2aafe52f748c818.en: -길래 is used in spoken Korean to express doing something based on an observed fact (seeing a sale).

a2aafe52f748c818.zh: 「려고」表示意圖或目的「為了……」，若選此項主語應相同且句意變為「為了打折而買」。
a2aafe52f748c818.en: 려고 indicates purpose (in order to), which changes the meaning unnaturally to buying clothes in order to hold a sale.

a2aafe52f748c818.zh: 「도록」表示程度或目的「以便、使得」，在此不合文意。
a2aafe52f748c818.en: 도록 expresses purpose or degree (so that), which does not fit the context of reacting to a sale.

a2aafe52f748c818.zh: 「더라도」表示讓步「即使……也」，填入後會變成「即使打折也買了兩件」，語意矛盾。
a2aafe52f748c818.en: 더라도 means even if, which creates an illogical statement: even if it was on sale, I bought clothes.

a3f28e39bc41a60f.en: 놀랍다 is a ㅂ-irregular adjective, taking -(으)ㄹ to become 놀라울 before 따름이었다.

a3f28e39bc41a60f.zh: 現在冠詞形「놀라운」無法與依託名詞句型「따름이다」搭配。
a3f28e39bc41a60f.en: Present modifier 놀라운 cannot be used with the bound noun structure 따름이다.

a3f28e39bc41a60f.zh: 原因詞尾「놀라워서」無法直接修飾名詞「따름」。
a3f28e39bc41a60f.en: Causal ending 놀라워서 cannot directly modify the bound noun 따름.

a3f28e39bc41a60f.zh: 過去冠詞形「놀라웠던」不能與句型「따름이다」搭配使用。
a3f28e39bc41a60f.en: Past retrospective form 놀라웠던 cannot combine with the pattern 따름이다.

a7ad70f708fc7a50.zh: 慣用語「아시다시피」表示「正如您所知道的那樣」。
a7ad70f708fc7a50.en: 아시다시피 is a fixed expression meaning 'as you know'.

a7ad70f708fc7a50.zh: 「-다시피」直接接在詞幹後，不可加上冠形詞尾「-는-」。
a7ad70f708fc7a50.en: -다시피 attaches directly to the stem, not after the noun-modifying ending -는-.

a7ad70f708fc7a50.zh: 「-느라」表示「因為忙於…而導致後果」，語意不符。
a7ad70f708fc7a50.en: -느라 indicates a negative result caused by doing an action, not 'as you know'.

a7ad70f708fc7a50.zh: 「-도록」表示目的或程度「以便、到…程度」，語意不符。
a7ad70f708fc7a50.en: -도록 expresses purpose or degree, which does not fit the context.

a851f7489cc31713.zh: 主語「그는」接副詞「결국」、賓語「병을」，「이겨」與後方「냈어요」組成慣用語。
a851f7489cc31713.en: Subject 그는 is followed by adverb 결국, object 병을, and verb 이겨, forming 이겨 냈어요.

a9cac6740e1c41d0.zh: 句型為「V-는 둥 마는 둥 하다」，此處固定填入否定形式「마는」。
a9cac6740e1c41d0.en: The pattern V-는 둥 마는 둥 (하다) fixedly uses the verb 말다 in the form 마는.

a9cac6740e1c41d0.zh: 此句型固定搭配輔助動詞「마는 둥」，不可用「안 자는」。
a9cac6740e1c41d0.en: The fixed construction uses the auxiliary verb 말다, so 안 자는 is unnatural.

a9cac6740e1c41d0.zh: 前句動詞為「자는」，句型對應項須為「마는」，不能換成「하는」。
a9cac6740e1c41d0.en: The pattern pairs V-는 with 마는; replacing it with 하는 breaks the idiom.

a9cac6740e1c41d0.zh: 若重複「자는」，無法表達「做還是沒做」的半吊子或勉強之意。
a9cac6740e1c41d0.en: Repeating 자는 fails to create the contrasting pair needed for this grammar.

aa412f66bb6cb122.zh: 時間副詞「그때」置於句首，冠詞「그」修飾「주식을」，再接假設詞尾「샀더라면」。
aa412f66bb6cb122.en: Place time adverb 그때 first, determiner 그 modifies 주식을, followed by conditional 샀더라면.

aa7abf56c512c799.zh: 「맛은 물론이고」後接「가격도 저렴해요」表示不僅美味而且價格便宜。
aa7abf56c512c799.en: After 맛은 물론이고, 가격도 저렴해요 naturally adds another positive feature: cheap prices.

aa7abf56c512c799.zh: 「맛이 별로예요」意思是不怎麼好吃，與前半句矛盾。
aa7abf56c512c799.en: 맛이 별로예요 means the food isn't great, contradicting the premise that it is good.

aa7abf56c512c799.zh: 「가격은 몰라요」表示不知道價格，無法承接물론이고並列優點。
aa7abf56c512c799.en: 가격은 몰라요 means not knowing the price, which doesn't fit the additive pattern 물론이고.

aa7abf56c512c799.zh: 「문을 닫았어요」表示關門了，語意無法承接食物美味的稱讚。
aa7abf56c512c799.en: 문을 닫았어요 means closed, which does not logically follow praising the taste with 물론이고.

aaf439e29e11fcc6.zh: 「에 불과하다」表示「只不過是…」，接在名詞後表示僅僅是開始。
aaf439e29e11fcc6.en: 에 불과하다 is a fixed expression meaning merely or only; 불과해요 correctly completes it.

aaf439e29e11fcc6.zh: 韓語中沒有「불과되다」這種搭配，固定使用「불과하다」。
aaf439e29e11fcc6.en: 불과되다 is not a natural Korean word; the fixed verb is 불과하다.

aaf439e29e11fcc6.zh: 韓語中沒有「불과있다」的說法，應搭配「하다」。
aaf439e29e11fcc6.en: 불과있다 does not exist; the expression strictly uses 하다 as 불과하다.

aaf439e29e11fcc6.zh: 「불과받다」是不存在的詞彙搭配，無法表達「只不過」。
aaf439e29e11fcc6.en: 불과받다 is completely incorrect; 불과하다 is the only valid verb form.

ab40acee6a38001a.zh: 受詞「돈을」接動詞「받은 이상」，後接主題「일은」。
ab40acee6a38001a.en: 돈을 is the object of 받은 이상, leading into the contrastive topic 일은.

ab6cb3206d73e4fc.zh: 「N치고」搭配否定表達「없어요」，表示只要是韓國人都無一例外吃過。
ab6cb3206d73e4fc.en: N치고 followed by a negative ending forms every Korean without exception.

ab6cb3206d73e4fc.zh: 「김치를 잘 먹네요」為肯定句，無法與「N치고」搭配表達全稱無例外。
ab6cb3206d73e4fc.en: 김치를 잘 먹네요 is affirmative; N치고 requires a negative ending.

ab6cb3206d73e4fc.zh: 「김치를 많이 먹었어요」為一般肯定句陳述，不符合此句型的否定呼應。
ab6cb3206d73e4fc.en: 김치를 많이 먹었어요 is affirmative and cannot follow the N치고 pattern.

ab6cb3206d73e4fc.zh: 「김치를 먹고 싶어요」為個人願望肯定句，無法構成全體無例外的意義。
ab6cb3206d73e4fc.en: 김치를 먹고 싶어요 expresses a desire, not the required negative structure.

acf60a584638c3ac.zh: 動詞詞幹接「는 가운데」表示在關注集中的情況下開始發表。
acf60a584638c3ac.en: Attaching 는 to the verb stem forms the modifier before 가운데, meaning amid focused attention.

acf60a584638c3ac.zh: 名詞化詞尾「기」不能直接修飾名詞「가운데」。
acf60a584638c3ac.en: The nominalizing suffix 기 cannot modify the noun 가운데.

acf60a584638c3ac.zh: 連接詞尾「고」用於連接前後子句，不能修飾「가운데」。
acf60a584638c3ac.en: The connective 고 joins clauses and cannot modify the noun 가운데.

acf60a584638c3ac.zh: 詞尾「어」不能直接修飾名詞「가운데」。
acf60a584638c3ac.en: The informal ending or connective 어 cannot modify a noun like 가운데.

ad5bff65359d9bb4.zh: 「-기 나름이다」中的「나름」搭配動詞「이다」，現在式為「나름이에요」。
ad5bff65359d9bb4.en: The pattern requires the copula 이다 after 나름, giving 나름이에요.
나름 cannot combine with 하다; 나름해요 is ungrammatical.
나름 cannot combine with 있다; 나름있어요 is ungrammatical.
나름 cannot combine with 되다; 나름돼요 is ungrammatical.

aeff4c1a3eb8c852.zh: 形容詞「좋다」有收音，接「-은 데 반해」表示對比。
aeff4c1a3eb8c852.en: The adjective 좋다 ends in a consonant, so it takes 은 to form 은 데 반해.

aeff4c1a3eb8c852.zh: 「-는 데 반해」用於動詞，形容詞有收音要接「-은」。
aeff4c1a3eb8c852.en: 는 is used with verbs; adjectives with a final consonant require 은.

aeff4c1a3eb8c852.zh: 「-을」是未來或推測冠形詞形，不符合句型。
aeff4c1a3eb8c852.en: 을 expresses prospective or hypothetical modification, which does not fit here.

aeff4c1a3eb8c852.zh: 「-아」是接續詞尾，不能直接接名詞「데」。
aeff4c1a3eb8c852.en: 아 is an inflectional ending and cannot directly modify 데.

afa2b1cf19a23381.zh: 「-아/어 내다」表示堅持到底完成難事，「완주하다」接「-여」成「완주해 냈다」。
afa2b1cf19a23381.en: -아/어 내다 means accomplishing a difficult task to the end; 완주하다 takes -여 to become 완주해 냈다.

afa2b1cf19a23381.zh: 「-고」是連接詞尾，不能與表示克服完成的輔助動詞「냈다」連用。
afa2b1cf19a23381.en: -고 simply connects actions sequentially, not forming the auxiliary compound with 냈다.

afa2b1cf19a23381.zh: 「났다」是「나다」（發生）的過去式，無克服艱難跑完全程的文法含義。
afa2b1cf19a23381.en: 났다 is from 나다, which does not convey the meaning of finishing a hard effort.

afa2b1cf19a23381.zh: 「-게」表示方式或目的，無法與「냈다」搭配表示跑完整個馬拉松。
afa2b1cf19a23381.en: -게 denotes manner or purpose, not the auxiliary expression for seeing an action through.

b08b58c8cd1dd431.zh: 此句型固定接現在式冠形詞尾「-는」，울다 去掉 ㄹ 變為「우는」。
b08b58c8cd1dd431.en: -는 통에 always uses -는; the irregular verb 울다 drops ㄹ to become 우는.

b08b58c8cd1dd431.zh: 「운」是過去式冠形詞尾，該文法固定接「-는 통에」。
b08b58c8cd1dd431.en: 운 is the past modifier; this grammar pattern specifically requires -는 통에.

b08b58c8cd1dd431.zh: 「울」是將來式冠形詞尾，不能與「통에」搭配表示原因。
b08b58c8cd1dd431.en: 울 is the future modifier, which cannot combine with 통에.

b08b58c8cd1dd431.zh: 「울어」是動詞非格式體形式，不能修飾名詞「통」。
b08b58c8cd1dd431.en: 울어 is an informal clause ending, which cannot modify the dependent noun 통.

b30a79a5750acc29.zh: 「-고자」用於正式書信或場合表達目的，「為了確認會議日程而發信」。
b30a79a5750acc29.en: -고자 formally expresses purpose: sending an email in order to confirm the meeting schedule.

b30a79a5750acc29.zh: 「-느라」表示因為進行某動作而導致負面結果，不表發信的目的。
b30a79a5750acc29.en: -느라 expresses a reason resulting in negative consequences, not a purpose.

b30a79a5750acc29.zh: 「-다가」表示動作中斷並轉移到另一動作，不表發信的目的。
b30a79a5750acc29.en: -다가 indicates an interrupted action transitioning to another, not purpose.

b30a79a5750acc29.zh: 「-더니」表示過去經歷的回想與對照或原因，不表目的。
b30a79a5750acc29.en: -더니 expresses past observation leading to a result or contrast, not purpose.

b33fbc9e37d210e7.zh: 「차라리」意為「寧可、乾脆」，常與「-느니」搭配表示兩害相權取其輕。
b33fbc9e37d210e7.en: 차라리 means 'rather' or 'preferably', pairing naturally with -느니.

b33fbc9e37d210e7.zh: 「아마」表示推測（大概、也許），不能與「-느니」搭配表達取捨。
b33fbc9e37d210e7.en: 아마 means 'probably' or 'maybe', expressing speculation rather than preference.

b33fbc9e37d210e7.zh: 「별로」表示程度不高（不太…），後需接否定形式。
b33fbc9e37d210e7.en: 별로 means 'not particularly' and requires a negative predicate.

b33fbc9e37d210e7.zh: 「결코」表示「絕不、斷然」，後方通常接否定形式。
b33fbc9e37d210e7.en: 결코 means 'never' and is followed by a strong negative.

b48ab9067052c6be.zh: 前半句使用假設過去相反事實的「-았/었더라면」，後半句通常搭配「-았/었을 거예요」表示推測過去會怎樣。
b48ab9067052c6be.en: A clause with -았/었더라면 expressing past counterfactuals regularly pairs with -았/었을 거예요 in the main clause.

b48ab9067052c6be.zh: 「붙을 거예요」是單純的未來推測（會合格），無法表示回顧過去「本來會合格」的假設後悔。
b48ab9067052c6be.en: 붙을 거예요 expresses a future prediction, which does not match the past counterfactual condition.

b48ab9067052c6be.zh: 「붙어요」是現在式，不能表達對過去相反假設的推測結果。
b48ab9067052c6be.en: 붙어요 is present tense, which cannot express a hypothetical outcome in the past.

b48ab9067052c6be.zh: 「붙었어요」是過去確定事實（合格了），與前半句「如果……的話」的假設語意矛盾。
b48ab9067052c6be.en: 붙었어요 states a past fact (passed), contradicting the hypothetical condition of having not passed.

b5b431582da547f2.zh: 配合前文「不僅在國內」，後句用「해외에서도」表示在海外也受歡迎。
b5b431582da547f2.en: Following domestic of course, 해외에서도 naturally adds in overseas too.

b5b431582da547f2.zh: 「만」表示僅限，與前面「不僅在國內」的遞進語意矛盾。
b5b431582da547f2.en: 만 means only, contradicting the additive meaning of not only domestically.

b5b431582da547f2.zh: 前面已提到「국내는」，此處重複「국내에서도」語意不通順。
b5b431582da547f2.en: The sentence already mentioned 국내는; repeating 국내에서도 makes no sense.

b5b431582da547f2.zh: 「별로」表示不太，與句尾「인기가 많다」（很有人氣）相衝突。
b5b431582da547f2.en: 별로 means not really, which contradicts the ending 인기가 많다.

bb594c3791b51d30.zh: 副詞「밤새」修飾「공부했으니」，後接句型「졸릴 만도 해요」。
bb594c3791b51d30.en: Time adverb 밤새 modifies the reason 공부했으니, which precedes the result pattern 졸릴 만도 해요.

bb6910021a14ed4f.zh: 副詞「조금」修飾「느릴지언정」，後接「정확하게 하는」修飾名詞句。
bb6910021a14ed4f.en: 조금 modifies 느릴지언정, which connects to the adverb 정확하게 modifying 하는 게 중요해요.

c1ab2cd972519412.zh: 「-는 통에」表示因混亂或吵鬧的狀況導致不好的結果。
c1ab2cd972519412.en: -는 통에 expresses that a noisy or chaotic situation caused a bad result.

c1ab2cd972519412.zh: 「-는 김에」表示「順便」，不符合因受干擾導致無法專心的語境。
c1ab2cd972519412.en: -는 김에 means 'while at it / taking the opportunity', which does not fit.

c1ab2cd972519412.zh: 「덕분에」表示「多虧…」，用於正面、感謝的結果，此處是負面結果。
c1ab2cd972519412.en: 덕분에 means 'thanks to' for positive outcomes, whereas this result is negative.

c1ab2cd972519412.zh: 「대신에」表示「代替」或「相反補償」，不符合因果干擾的語境。
c1ab2cd972519412.en: 대신에 means 'instead of', which does not convey a chaotic cause.

c1be0749b1a8761b.zh: 動詞「굶다」有收尾音，接「-을지언정」表示「寧可挨餓也不……」。
c1be0749b1a8761b.en: 굶다 has a consonant stem, so it takes -을지언정 to express I would rather starve.

c1be0749b1a8761b.zh: 無收尾音才接「-ㄹ지언정」，且沒有「-는지언정」這種形態。
c1be0749b1a8761b.en: -는지언정 is not a valid connective form for this grammar point.

c1be0749b1a8761b.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ수록」表示「越……越……」，與句中的寧可決心無關。
c1be0749b1a8761b.en: -(으)ㄹ수록 means the more... the more, which does not fit.

c1be0749b1a8761b.zh: 「-느라고」表示因忙於某動作而帶來負面影響，無法表達寧可的決心。
c1be0749b1a8761b.en: -느라고 indicates a cause resulting in a negative outcome, not resolve.

c23498811ab36707.zh: 句型「-기 십상이다」接在動詞「찌다」後，敬體為「찌기 십상이에요」。
c23498811ab36707.en: The correct pattern with verb 찌다 is 찌기 십상이에요 using the copula 이다.

c23498811ab36707.zh: 「십상」需搭配助動詞「이다」，不能與「하다」結合說成「십상해요」。
c23498811ab36707.en: 십상 takes copula 이다; 십상해요 is ungrammatical.

c23498811ab36707.zh: 該句型必須使用名詞化詞尾「-기」，不可用冠詞形「찌는」。
c23498811ab36707.en: The pattern requires nominalizer -기, not the adnominal ending 찌는.
십상 takes copula 이다; 십상있어요 is ungrammatical.

c254b0b3fad46433.zh: 「-는 한이 있더라도」表示即使付出極大代價，動詞幹接「는」。
c254b0b3fad46433.en: The pattern -는 한이 있더라도 attaches directly to the verb stem using 는.

c254b0b3fad46433.zh: 「은」是過去形冠形詞尾，不能與「한이 있더라도」搭配使用。
c254b0b3fad46433.en: 은 is the past noun-modifying ending and cannot form this fixed grammatical pattern.

c254b0b3fad46433.zh: 「을」是未來形冠形詞尾，此慣用句型必須使用現在形「는」。
c254b0b3fad46433.en: 을 is the prospective noun-modifying ending, but this pattern requires 는.

c254b0b3fad46433.zh: 「고」為連接詞尾，無法修飾後方的名詞「한」。
c254b0b3fad46433.en: 고 is a connective ending and cannot modify the dependent noun 한.

c2a6a2bce0c76010.zh: 對過去未做的事情表達遺憾假設，必須使用「-았/었더라면」，「하다」規則變為「했더라면」。
c2a6a2bce0c76010.en: -았/었더라면 expresses regretful hypothetical past conditions; 하다 correctly conjugates to 했더라면.

c2a6a2bce0c76010.zh: 「하더라면」缺少過去時制標記「-았/었-」，不能用於假設過去與事實相反的狀況。
c2a6a2bce0c76010.en: 하더라면 lacks the past tense infix, which is required for past counterfactual conditionals.

c2a6a2bce0c76010.zh: 「했더라도」表示「即使預約了……也」，表讓步轉折，與後文「本來會有位子」語意不合。
c2a6a2bce0c76010.en: 했더라도 means even if we had reserved, which creates a concessive clause that does not fit the intended meaning.

c2a6a2bce0c76010.zh: 「했길래」表示因為前面做了某事，是敘述已發生的原因，非假設句型。
c2a6a2bce0c76010.en: 했길래 indicates a reason based on a past action, not a hypothetical past condition.

c4fb7d50c5e9733e.zh: 句型固定使用現在式冠形詞尾「-는」，接動詞幹成「하는 둥 마는 둥」。
c4fb7d50c5e9733e.en: The pattern V-는 둥 마는 둥 requires the present attributive ending -는 on the verb.

c4fb7d50c5e9733e.zh: 「한」是過去式冠形詞尾，此句型固定使用「-는」。
c4fb7d50c5e9733e.en: 한 has the past attributive -ㄴ, but this pattern strictly requires -는.

c4fb7d50c5e9733e.zh: 「할」是未來或推測冠形詞尾，無法與「둥 마는 둥」搭配。
c4fb7d50c5e9733e.en: 할 uses the prospective ending -ㄹ, which is incompatible with this pattern.

c4fb7d50c5e9733e.zh: 「하기」是名詞形字尾，無法修飾不完全名詞「둥」。
c4fb7d50c5e9733e.en: 하기 is a nominalized verb form, which cannot modify the bound noun 둥.

c535520a348186b1.zh: 「-(으)ㄴ 가운데」為常用禮貌表達，表示「在百忙之中」。
c535520a348186b1.en: 바쁘신 가운데 is a standard formal expression meaning in the midst of your busy schedule.

c535520a348186b1.zh: 「탓에」表示因負面原因造成不良後果，不能用於表達感謝。
c535520a348186b1.en: 탓에 blames a cause for a bad result, making it inappropriate in an expression of gratitude.

c535520a348186b1.zh: 「바람에」表示受意外原因影響導致消極結果，不可用於致謝。
c535520a348186b1.en: 바람에 indicates an unexpected influence leading to a negative outcome, which does not fit thanks.

c535520a348186b1.zh: 「대신」表示代替或補償，文意上並不通順。
c535520a348186b1.en: 대신 means instead of or in return for, which makes no sense here.

c55a504e95650896.zh: 「하다」接「-아/어」縮約為「해」，組成「불평을 해 대다」（不停抱怨）。
c55a504e95650896.en: 하- combines with -여 to become 해, correctly forming the pattern 해 대다.

c55a504e95650896.zh: 「-고」表示並列，無法與補助動詞「대다」連用。
c55a504e95650896.en: -고 cannot link to the auxiliary verb 대다 to show repeated action.

c55a504e95650896.zh: 「-는」為名詞修飾詞尾，不能接補助動詞「대다」。
c55a504e95650896.en: -는 is an adnominal suffix and cannot connect to auxiliary 대다.

c55a504e95650896.zh: 「-게」表示方式或目的，無法構成反覆動作的「-아/어 대다」。
c55a504e95650896.en: -게 shows purpose or manner and does not combine with 대다.

c56927c2b195b140.zh: 「-아/어 내다」表示費盡心力終於解出難題，「풀다」搭配「-어」成「풀어 냈다」。
c56927c2b195b140.en: -아/어 내다 expresses managing to do something difficult; 풀다 takes -어 to form 풀어 냈다.

c56927c2b195b140.zh: 「-고」表示並列或順序，不能與輔助動詞「냈다」連用表示完成。
c56927c2b195b140.en: -고 expresses listing and cannot connect to auxiliary 냈다 to mean managing to do it.

c56927c2b195b140.zh: 「-아/어 나다」不是表示完成困難動作的正確文法結構。
c56927c2b195b140.en: -아/어 나다 is not the proper auxiliary grammar to indicate working out a solution.

c56927c2b195b140.zh: 「-게」表示使動或目的，不能接「냈다」來表達獨自解出難題。
c56927c2b195b140.en: -게 indicates purpose or result, not the auxiliary pattern for completing a hard task.

c8333ac8cdab7b58.zh: 受詞「날씨를」接否定條件句「확인하지 않으면」，再接「고생하기 십상이에요」。
c8333ac8cdab7b58.en: Object 날씨를 connects to conditional 확인하지 않으면, leading into the bad result pattern 고생하기 십상이에요.

c9de2667b34084ca.zh: 主詞「사람들이」接動詞修飾語「밀치는」，再接表示原因的「통에」，後接結果「넘어질」。
c9de2667b34084ca.en: The subject 사람들이 leads to 밀치는 modifying 통에 to show the cause, followed by 넘어질 before 뻔했어요.

c9ff18bad705e0c7.zh: 「-다가는」表示照這樣下去會有不好結果（遲到），接在動詞詞幹「가-」後成「가다가는」。
c9ff18bad705e0c7.en: -다가는 attaches to verb stem 가- to warn that continuing like this will lead to a bad result (being late).

c9ff18bad705e0c7.zh: 「-느라고」表示因為專注於某事而產生不好的結果，通常用於主語已發生的行為，不合句意。
c9ff18bad705e0c7.en: -느라고 indicates that an ongoing action caused an actual negative result, not a hypothetical warning.

c9ff18bad705e0c7.zh: 「-고자」表示意圖或目的，與後面的「會遲到」語意不合。
c9ff18bad705e0c7.en: -고자 expresses an intention or purpose, which does not fit the context of being late.

c9ff18bad705e0c7.zh: 「-길래」表示根據觀察到的原因，不能用來表示「如果照這樣下去……」的假定警告。
c9ff18bad705e0c7.en: -길래 gives a reason based on observation, not a conditional warning predicting a negative outcome.

ca9dce48bd714a00.zh: 「혼자」修飾「외로울지언정」，後接賓語「나쁜 친구는」搭配後方動詞。
ca9dce48bd714a00.en: 혼자 modifies 외로울지언정, which is followed by the object 나쁜 친구는 completing the sentence.

cb360b8ea5608d26.zh: 動詞「돌아가다」接「-는 법이다」，表達越急越要繞道走的常理。
cb360b8ea5608d26.en: 돌아가다 is a verb, so it takes -는 법이다 to state a general truth.
기 is used with 마련이다, not with the noun 법.

cb360b8ea5608d26.zh: 「을」是未來或推測冠詞形，不符合表達普遍真理的句型。
cb360b8ea5608d26.en: 을 denotes future or prospective tense, which is not used with 법이다.

cb360b8ea5608d26.zh: 「아서」表示連接或原因，不能直接修飾依託名詞「법」。
cb360b8ea5608d26.en: 아서 indicates cause or sequence and cannot directly modify 법.

cf162c536708598e.zh: 固定句型為「-는 한이 있더라도」，表示「即使…也要…」。
cf162c536708598e.en: The set expression is -는 한이 있더라도, meaning even if it comes to that.

cf162c536708598e.zh: 「없더라도」表示「即使沒有」，不符合「한이 있다」的慣用表達。
cf162c536708598e.en: 없더라도 means even if there is not, which does not fit this fixed idiom.

cf162c536708598e.zh: 「있어서」表示原因或狀態，無法表達讓步「即使」的決心語氣。
cf162c536708598e.en: 있어서 expresses cause or situation, not a concessive resolution.

cf162c536708598e.zh: 「있으면」表示單純條件「如果有」，不能表達不惜代價的決心。
cf162c536708598e.en: 있으면 expresses a simple conditional if, lacking the concessive resolve.

d0ff3c76dee4ab57.en: 있다 takes 는 to form the present modifier in 있는 이상.

d0ff3c76dee4ab57.zh: 「-은」用於有收音的形容詞或動詞過去式，不接「있다」。
d0ff3c76dee4ab57.en: 은 does not attach to 있다 in the present modifier form.

d0ff3c76dee4ab57.zh: 「-을」表未來或推測，不符合「法律存在」的既成事實。
d0ff3c76dee4ab57.en: 을 denotes prospective or hypothetical states, which does not fit here.
기 creates a nominalized form and cannot modify the noun 이상.

d17f53c795390d34.zh: 副詞「더」修飾「나은」，修飾賓語「서비스를」，再接表示意圖的「제공하고자」。
d17f53c795390d34.en: 더 modifies 나은, which describes the object 서비스를, followed by 제공하고자 expressing intention before 노력하겠습니다.

d324a67eded76d18.zh: 「십 분에 불과했다」符合「N에 불과하다」句型，表示「只不過是十分鐘」。
d324a67eded76d18.en: 십 분에 불과했다 follows the pattern N에 불과하다, meaning it was only ten minutes.

d324a67eded76d18.zh: 「불과하다」前面必須搭配助詞「에」，不能用主格助詞「이」。
d324a67eded76d18.en: The expression requires the particle 에 rather than the subject marker 이.

d324a67eded76d18.zh: 「에게」用於人或動物等有生名詞，不能用於時間「십 분」。
d324a67eded76d18.en: 에게 is used with animate nouns (people or animals), not time units.

d324a67eded76d18.zh: 此句型固定搭配助詞「에」，不能使用表示方式或方向的「으로」。
d324a67eded76d18.en: This fixed pattern uses 에, not the instrumental or directional particle 으로.

d40f46d10b341399.zh: 「-고서야 어떻게 -(으)ㄹ 수 있겠어요?」表反問，表示「怎能做好」。
d40f46d10b341399.en: Pairs with -고서야 어떻게 to form a rhetorical question: how could you possibly do well?

d40f46d10b341399.zh: 「잘했어요」是過去肯定句「做好了」，無法配合反問句型「어떻게 …?」。
d40f46d10b341399.en: This is a past statement, did well, which does not fit the rhetorical question pattern with 어떻게.

d40f46d10b341399.zh: 「잘하고 있어요」是現在進行式，無法與反問詞「어떻게」自然搭配結尾。
d40f46d10b341399.en: This is a progressive statement, am doing well, which does not form a natural rhetorical question with 어떻게.

d40f46d10b341399.zh: 「잘할게요」表示說話者的承諾或意志「我會做好的」，不能用於反問句。
d40f46d10b341399.en: This expresses the speaker's promise or intention, I will do well, not a rhetorical question.

d59cc581f4697af1.zh: 形容詞「예쁘다」無收音，接現在冠形詞尾「-ㄴ」修飾「데 반해」。
d59cc581f4697af1.en: The adjective 예쁘다 takes -(으)ㄴ to modify 데 반해, creating the contrast whereas it is pretty.

d59cc581f4697af1.zh: 形容詞現在形不可接動詞冠形詞尾「-는」。
d59cc581f4697af1.en: Adjectives cannot take the present noun-modifying suffix 는.

d59cc581f4697af1.zh: 「예뻐서」為原因連接詞尾，不能修飾依託名詞「데」。
d59cc581f4697af1.en: 예뻐서 is a causal connective ending and cannot modify the dependent noun 데.

d59cc581f4697af1.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ」表示將來推測，此處描述手機外觀的現狀事實。
d59cc581f4697af1.en: 예쁠 expresses future or conjecture, whereas this sentence contrasts current facts.

d7fb212c3d48e320.zh: 動詞詞幹「맞-」接「-기」構成「-기 십상이다」，表示容易淋雨。
d7fb212c3d48e320.en: Verb stem 맞- takes -기 to form -기 십상이다, meaning likely to get rained on.

d7fb212c3d48e320.zh: 「맞는」為冠詞形，句型「-기 십상이다」必須使用「-기」。
d7fb212c3d48e320.en: 맞는 is an adnominal form; the pattern requires nominalizer -기.

d7fb212c3d48e320.zh: 「맞아」為非格式體非敬語詞尾，不能直接接「십상이에요」。
d7fb212c3d48e320.en: 맞아 is an informal verb ending and cannot connect to 십상이에요.

d7fb212c3d48e320.zh: 「맞을」為未來定語詞尾，不能與「십상이에요」搭配。
d7fb212c3d48e320.en: 맞을 is a future adnominal form and cannot precede 십상이에요.
